chapters.title: Chapter 1771 You were saying?
paragraphs: Piercing Reality.
One of the strongest abilities the Etheryns were known for.An ability that could disable a being's connection to their very power, taking away all their abilities and even sealing their Law.

Honestly, in the state Nux was in, this ability wasn't a threat to him. He could barely use his abilities and Laws right now anyway. However, if he was hit by this arrow, whatever abilities he could use would be taken away as well.

His regeneration would stop, he wouldn't be able to use Absolute Kinesis or teleport when required. He would only be able to rely on his physical strength and honestly... with how things were playing out, that didn't seem like something he wanted to try.
Nux knew that he needed to avoid this attack no matter what.
Fortunately, Piercing Reality was slower than Zyros's other arrows, giving him enough time to teleport.
Well, or at least that's what he would like to do if Vrakor gave him time.
But the Titan didn't.
"DIE!"
The Titan appeared next to him, slamming his fists in a way that, if he succeeded, he would send Nux flying toward the incoming arrow.
BOOM
And he did succeed.
Nux was too slow to dodge or even block his fists. In the end, he was attacked, and his body was sent flying.
However, before Vrakor could celebrate, he saw the smile that had appeared on Nux's face.
"No!"
He screamed inwardly as he realized his mistake, but it was already too late.
Nux, who was about to be hit by the arrow, suddenly disappeared.
He allowed Vrakor to attack him because he wanted to use this moment to teleport.
again. As for Vrakor's attack breaking around 12 bones in his ribcage and the pain he felt from it?
Well, it wasn't like this was something new for him.
Pain, he could bear. Surviving here was much more important.
"Vrakor! What are you doing!? You were supposed to hold him!"
Zyros screamed in anger. He wanted this battle to end as soon as possible, but seeing that Nux had gotten away made him boil with rage.
Vrakor had no excuses.
"Blaze of Destruction!"
Kaelith, on the other hand, had already started attacking Nux, who had teleported to a different location, unleashing a concentrated blast of flame at him.
Nux, however, teleported again, dodging the incoming attack without any problems.
Gragor rushed towards him, appearing next to him as he swung his axe. Nux, however, continued to dodge his attacks.
Without Vrakor, Nux had one less thing to worry about. He could focus all his senses on Gragor, who attacked relentlessly. And as he did that,
Something started to change.
Nux's body began to react. His arms started moving, blocking the attacks that came at him, this time with more precision and sustaining fewer injuries.
Even the flames that Kaelith rew at him, his b
I and dodged them all. A few
moments later, Vrakor got involved in the battle as the Titan and the Ironfang continued
to work together and overpower Nux. But now...
He was hanging on...
The more they attacked him, the more his body learned.
His breathing grew steadier.
Slowly, his reflexes turned sharper and sharper, his movements becoming less clumsy.
He could do it...
His body was adjusting...
Yes, his monstrous adaptation had kicked in.
Now he didn't have to use Absolute Kinesis or Absolute Step every time he moved to maintain his balance. He could do it without using any of his abilities now.
And as he realized it,
Nux grinned.
Whoosh
Suddenly, an arrow was shot at him. Just like before, Nux caught the arrow and once again,
BOOOOM
The arrow exploded, and maybe because the strength behind the explosion was too
strong, instead of being sent flying because of the explosion, Nux's body was obliterated
into pieces.
Surprising everyone present.
"Is... is it over...?"
Vrakor frowned.
Didn't it end... a little too abruptly?
Sure, Nux was injured, his body was in a dire state, but to think it would be obliterated
with such an attack...
Was Zyros hiding a trump card all this time?
BOOOOOOM
Suddenly, Vrakor and the others heard an explosion.
They widened their eyes in horror as they realized where the sound came from and
quickly turned around.
There...
They saw Nux standing in a place where Kaelith was supposed to be.
The three Primordials then saw Kaelith's feet losing their balance and falling to the
ground. They finally realized what happened.
Kaelith's body was obliterated.
The only part of his body left were the feet they saw before...
Another one of their allies had fallen.
"Just as I thought...
A Clone wouldn't have my physical strength; it could only clone abilities that use my
energy."
Nux commented.
Seeing how his clone couldn't even last a single second, he was quite disappointed.
Then, however, he just shrugged.
"Oh well, it did its job.
The annoying fire dude is dealt with."
Then, Nux glanced at the other Primordials, and a terrifying grin appeared on his face.
"One down.
Three more to go."
Nux hurled himself forward, ignoring the pain coursing through his body.
He reached Gragor first, his fist connecting with the Ironfang's gut, sending him flying.

This time, however, he was in more control over his body. The strength he used this time was much higher than before, so much that Gragor's armor that he was so proud of had shattered into pieces, scaring him to his core.
Nux wanted to use his shaken state to end him as well, but Vrakor appeared right next to
him.
"Aaggghhh!!"
Vrakor screamed, gathering his Titan might as he launched his fist at Nux.
Nux extended his hand, ready to block his attack.
BOOOOOM
Once again, the Titan and a being who had devoured worlds collided. This time,
however, the result was far different.
Nux, who had focused his regeneration on his right arm, was holding Vrakor's hand with
a smile on his face.
"Didn't I say it before? Your blood is too weak for you to try and associate yourself with
me."
Nux then started pulling Vrakor's arm.
"If I don't even want you to associate with me..."
He continued to speak. Vrakor tried to free himself from his grip, but Nux was simply too
strong.
"Then what makes you think you are allowed to punch me?"
Nux questioned, and then,
Rip
"AAAAAAAGGGGHHHHHHHH!!!"
He tore Vrakor's arm apart.
The Titan screamed in pain.
Whoosh
An arrow came Nux's way.
"You shouldn't use this attack.
It is too slow,"
Nux chuckled as he then tossed Vrakor's arm towards the arrow. The arrow and the arm
collided, and suddenly, a hum sounded all over the place.
"W-What...?"
Vrakor's eyes widened in fright as he realized that his connection to his power was
broken.
Yes, Piercing Reality worked even when it hit a severed limb, that was how strong it was.
"ZYROS! WHAT IN THE HELL ARE YOU DOING!?"
He screamed in anger.
Nux jumped at him, but before he could attack, Gragor appeared behind him, ready to
protect his ally and take Nux by surprise. But...
"So predictable~" Nux's body burst into blood mist, completely avoiding Gragor's axe that was aimed at his
head.
He then appeared behind Gragor and grabbed the Ironfang's neck with a demonic smile
on his face.
Thud
The Ironfang's grip over his axe momentarily weakened, and his prided axe fell to the
ground.
He tried to pick it up, but Nux stepped on his axe and as he used his full power,
*Crack*
He broke it into two pieces.
"YOU BAST- Khhrrrhkk!!"
Gragor screamed in anger, but before he could do much, Nux, who was grabbing his
neck, lifted him into the air and,
"You were saying?"

Then, Nux glanced at the other Primordials, and a terrifying grin appeared on his face.
"One down.
Three more to go."
Nux hurled himself forward, ignoring the pain coursing through his body.
He reached Gragor first, his fist connecting with the Ironfang's gut, sending him flying.
This time, however, he was in more control over his body.
The strength he used this time was much higher than before, so much that Gragor's armor that he was so proud of had shattered into pieces, scaring him to his core.
Nux wanted to use his shaken state to end him as well, but Vrakor appeared right next to
him.
"Aaggghhh!!"
Vrakor screamed, gathering his Titan might as he launched his fist at Nux.
Nux extended his hand, ready to block his attack.
BOOOOOM
Once again, the Titan and a being who had devoured worlds collided.
This time,
however, the result was far different.
Nux, who had focused his regeneration on his right arm, was holding Vrakor's hand with
a smile on his face.
"Didn't I say it before?
Your blood is too weak for you to try and associate yourself with
me."
Nux then started pulling Vrakor's arm.
"If I don't even want you to associate with me..."
He continued to speak.
Vrakor tried to free himself from his grip, but Nux was simply too
strong.
"Then what makes you think you are allowed to punch me?"
Nux questioned, and then,
Rip
"AAAAAAAGGGGHHHHHHHH!!!"
He tore Vrakor's arm apart.
The Titan screamed in pain.
Whoosh
An arrow came Nux's way.
"You shouldn't use this attack.
It is too slow,"
Nux chuckled as he then tossed Vrakor's arm towards the arrow.
The arrow and the arm
collided, and suddenly, a hum sounded all over the place.
"W-What...?"
Vrakor's eyes widened in fright as he realized that his connection to his power was
broken.
Yes, Piercing Reality worked even when it hit a severed limb, that was how strong it was.
"ZYROS!
WHAT IN THE HELL ARE YOU DOING!?"
He screamed in anger.
Nux jumped at him, but before he could attack, Gragor appeared behind him, ready to
protect his ally and take Nux by surprise.
But...
"So predictable~" Nux's body burst into blood mist, completely avoiding Gragor's axe that was aimed at his
head.
He then appeared behind Gragor and grabbed the Ironfang's neck with a demonic smile
on his face.
Thud
The Ironfang's grip over his axe momentarily weakened, and his prided axe fell to the
ground.
He tried to pick it up, but Nux stepped on his axe and as he used his full power,
*Crack*
He broke it into two pieces.
"YOU BAST- Khhrrrhkk!!"
Gragor screamed in anger, but before he could do much, Nux, who was grabbing his
neck, lifted him into the air and,
"You were saying?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1772 Stay put. I will come for you at the end.
paragraphs: "YOU BAST-Khhrrrhkk!!"
Gragor screamed in anger, but before he could do much, Nux, who was grabbing his neck, lifted him in the air.
"You were saying?"

Nux questioned with a light smile on his face, staring right into the Ironfang's eyes. The sight of his scorched face and destroyed right eye combined with that maniacal smile horrified Gragor to his core.

He tried to move, doing everything in his power to free himself from Nux's grip. However, every time he struggled, Nux strengthened his grip, strangling him further, making it difficult for him to even breathe, let alone use any ability.

One had to know, this was the same man who tore off a Titan's arm with his brute strength. Ironfangs were strong, yes, but most of their strength came from their armor. They could never be compared to Titans when it came to physical strength.
As for a being who overpowered a Titan in a battle of strength?
Gragor stood no chance.
"YOU BASTARD!!!"
Vrakor, who saw his ally's and his own state, lost his reasoning and rushed toward Nux.
Even though his connection to his power was severed, he could still rely on his physical strength.
Of course, it was a foolish decision.
He couldn't face Nux even when he had all his powers. Thinking he could do it now that he had lost his powers and an arm... it was nothing more than a pipe dream.
Nux grabbed Gragor's head with his left arm that still wasn't healed yet. Then, with a crazy smile on his face, he waited for Vrakor to get close to them, giving him the slightest flicker of hope.
And the moment Vrakor got close,
"Ahh~ you were just a tad bit late.
Truly unfortunate."
Nux spoke. The smile on his face, however, never faded away.
Vrakor screamed, extending his left arm toward Nux, wanting to stop him, but... "AAAGGGGGGHHHHHH!!!"
Rip
In the midst of Gragor's horrified screams, Nux tore his head off.
Blood flowed out of Gragor's torso like a fountain, covering Nux's face.
Usually, Nux would use Absolute Kinesis or some other ability to not get dirty. Right now, however, he didn't stop it.
With a crazed smile on his face, he let the blood fall on him as he stared at the man's ally, who was looking at him with a pale look on his face.
It was a nightmarish sight Vrakor would never forget in his entire life.
"Two down.
Two more to go."
Nux commented with a bloodied grin as he then threw Gragor's head toward Vrakor.
The Titan grabbed the head with a lost look on his face.
"You are more shaken than I expected.
Was he your lover or something?"
Nux, who appeared next to Vrakor, questioned.
Vrakor reacted at the last second, but it was already too late. Nux's hand was already right in front of his face.
"Don't worry, I won't judge you."
Nux spoke as he then smashed the Titan's head into the ground.
"I have many other reasons to not like you."
He spoke as he grabbed another arrow shot at him.
"This is getting old, you know?"
He turned toward Zyros and,
"Stay put.
I will come for you at the end."

The moment he heard those words, Zyros felt his body tremble. He was terrified. After all, from the very start, this bastard had been targeting him. Not to mention, he had nearly killed that woman before.
Just thinking about what this monster had prepared for him made his legs tremble.
Zyros made a quick decision.
Three out of five Primordials who had come here were dead. Saving the last one wasn't possible either. He was hit by Piercing Reality. In that state, he was more of a dead weight than an ally.
The other mercenaries, including Valhelm, had died due to the aftereffects of the battle
as well.
Their 'party' didn't exist anymore.
So Zyros decided to make a run for it.
He believed that Vrakor, with his strong body, would buy him enough time to get away.
Thinking this far, Zyros decided to turn around and run away.
However, the moment he turned around, he saw Nux standing in front of him.
"You lot really are too predictable, huh..."
Nux chuckled.
BOOOM
Zyros turned around and saw that the arrow he had aimed at Nux exploded. Once again, the 'Nux' who was holding the arrow was obliterated into pieces. However, this time,
together with him,
Vrakor faced the full brunt of his attack. The Titan who couldn't use his energy was completely helpless against the explosion.
The only reason he even survived was because of his strong body. But right now, that seemed more like a curse than a blessing.
After all, even if his body ensured his survival, the state he was in was anything but good.

One of his arms was already torn off before. Now, both his legs had evaporated. The rest of his body was trembling without stop. His flesh was burnt. He was in pain, so much pain that he wanted to end his own life.
However, he couldn't even do that.
Even moving an inch was impossible in his current state. Right now, the only thing he could do was continue to burn his Life Force to hasten his death...
A horrifying end for any being in this Universe.
"Your attacks seem to specifically target him.
Do you have some bad blood with him or something?"
Nux questioned with a curious look on his face. Zyros, however, wasn't the one to let his emotions get the better of him.
Seeing that Nux was right in front of him, he instantly activated his strongest defensive
ability.
Astral Anchoring.
Zyros didn't have a strong body like Vrakor. However, this didn't mean that he didn't
have a way to protect himself.

Etheryn archers had the ability to anchor themselves to the fabric of space, making them immune to being physically displaced or destroyed by overwhelming force. A punch that could obliterate mountains might shatter the ground around them, but the
Etheryn would remain untouched.

This was one of the abilities that made Etheryns so troublesome to deal with. Not only did they have the ability to never miss their target, unbreakable weapons, and arrows that could pierce the very reality itself, their defense was also top-tier.
They could honestly stand in one place and continue attacking without a care in the
world if they had enough energy.
Once the Astral Anchoring was activated, they were untouchable.
Or at least that is what Zyros thought.
"Did you forget?"
Suddenly, Nux questioned.
Zyros narrowed his eyes, not saying anything.
He didn't want to fall for any of Nux's tricks.
Seeing this, Nux just smiled and continued,
"I knew you were an Etheryn from the very start."
Nux answered.
Zyros frowned, not knowing what Nux was trying to say. But then,
"Did you think I wouldn't have something against your race's trump card before I
engaged in battle?"
Nux spoke. Zyros widened his eyes in fright. However, before he could react, Nux
suddenly tapped his chest with his palm.
Soul Severance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1773 Soul Severance.
paragraphs: "Did you think I wouldn't have something against your race's trump card before I engage in battle?"
The moment Zyros heard those words, he widened his eyes in horror. He wanted to move, but it was already too late.
Tap
Before Zyros could react, Nux raised his hand and placed his palm gently against Zyros's chest.
The motion was deceptively simple, almost too gentle-completely different from the violent, bloodied blows that had defined their battle so far.
Zyros was confused, thinking whatever Nux was planning didn't work.
And then it happened.
Whoosh
Zyros was pushed back.
"W-What...?"
He was in disbelief.
He... He was moving...
His eyes then fell on something...
"T-That's..."
It was his body that remained standing, rigid and lifeless.
Zyros blinked, looking down at his hands, only to find them semi-transparent and glowing faintly.
Once again, his gaze darted to his still, upright body in front of him, staring blankly into the distance. Its bluish glow had now disappeared; it was as if the body was devoid of life.
"No... this isn't possible!" Zyros's voice was frantic, echoing unnaturally in the air.
"What have you done to me?!"
He screamed.
Nux just smiled as he dusted off his hands.
"You gave me too much time to prepare."
Normally, as a Sovereign, none of his abilities would work on a Primordial because of the difference in energies, but...
He had been preparing for more than a few seconds now.
Ever since Zyros aimed his arrow at him and Vrakor, Nux's original body was standing right behind him, preparing his final attack.
Why didn't he kill him before he could activate his Astral Anchoring?
Well, that would have been too easy, wouldn't it?
What if Soul Severance hadn't worked?
Heh, that was simply impossible.
Nux had seen Soul Severance work against Astral Anchoring hundreds of thousands of times.
Etheryns attracted Umbrasol Progenitors' attention, and for any race, this was anything but good news.
Those knowledge-craving Progenitors, in their relentless pursuit of understanding, had conducted countless experiments on the races that intrigued them.
Everything Nux learned from their twisted insights gave him absolute confidence because that was simply how thorough those beings were.
Never once, since the start of the battle, did Nux doubt whether Soul Severance would be effective.
Zyros was up against the worst possible matchup.
"I told you, did I not?
This won't be quick."
Nux spoke, his voice sounded like it belonged to a demon who came from the deepest level of worlds, shaking the very essence of Zyros.
Horrified, he tried to run away. He didn't have too much control over his 'body,' but he could still 'float' in the air as if he were swimming.
It was a feeble attempt, but he was getting away from Nux.
Soon, however, something made him frown.
Nux...
He wasn't stopping him...
Rather, he was only observing him with an unsettling calm.
'Fuck it!'
There were too many questions in his head. Zyros, however, stopped thinking about everything and continued to get away from this monster.
He had tried it already. In this form, he couldn't summon his Bow anymore, so attacking was already out of the question. He could only escape!
But suddenly...
His body stopped.
It was as if he had hit an invisible wall.
He struggled, doing everything in his power to push his body forward, but no matter how much effort he exerted, he couldn't move another inch.
"What.... What is this?" Zyros's voice trembled.
In the end, he turned back to Nux, who had been observing him with an amused grin all
this while.
"Going somewhere?" he asked casually, his tone full of mockery.
"What have you done to me!?"
He asked again, his voice laced with panic.
"It is called Soul Severance," Nux finally answered.
"It was once quite a popular technique that almost everyone in the Universe feared."
Nux then glanced at Zyros and chuckled.
"I guess you are quite young since you do not know about it."
Of course, 'young' here meant less than hundreds of thousands of years before Umbrasol became uninhabitable and its people perished.
"What did you do!?"
Zyros didn't care about anything Nux said. He just wanted to know what happened to
him, and like the good and gentle man Nux was, he answered.
"I separated your soul and body. It's pretty handy when dealing with people who think they're untouchable."
Zyros's ethereal form trembled as he stared at his body in disbelief.
"This... is my Soul...?'
He tried moving back to his body, this time, his speed much faster compared to when he
was trying to get away.
As he reached closer, he tried to reach out to his body instinctively, trying to become one again, but his hands passed through his physical form like mist.
The realization sank in.
The connection between his Physical Body and Soul was completely severed. He
couldn't reenter.
"You...
Zyros's voice shook.
"You-how did you-?"
Nux smiled, his expression calm, almost fatherly, as if he were consoling a frightened
child.
"Yes, yes, I understand. It's overwhelming at first," he nodded continuously.
"But don't worry."
For a moment, his expression seemed genuine, and then,
His smile twisted into something darker, something demonic.
"Things are going to get much, much worse.
So much worse that these things would soon feel minor discomfort to you."
Nux's grin widened.
Zyros's soul shook, and Nux started walking toward him.
"You see, there was a reason why Soul Severance was feared throughout the Universe
despite there being only a few people capable of using it.
It was one of the cruelest to have ever existed in the large history of this Universe.
A merciless technique that ensures the severed soul's future will be nothing short of a
waking nightmare.
And do you know what's worse?"
Nux questioned.
"A Soul
bound to its Physical Body. Even if the Soul Severance separates the two, the
connection is still there. A Soul simply cannot exist without the body."
Zyros's eyes widened as he realized what Nux was trying to say.
"Yes, you figured it out."
Nux nodded as he suddenly grabbed Zyros's physical body and,
"As long as I have this body, you cannot escape.
Your Physical Body is in a partially dead state and in your Soul Form, you cannot use any
of your abilities or your Law.
Do you realize what that means?
It means that without any external help, you are utterly helpless.
And trust me, Zyros,
Where I am going to take you, there will be no help, especially for a run-away like you
who left his World and settled far away as a mercenary."

"NO!
You are lying!!
You are trying to fool me!!"
Zyros screamed, floating away from Nux again, and once again, Nux just smiled, letting him do whatever he wanted.
Yes, he was that confident.
He remembered how the Umbrasol Progenitors had stored thousands of bodies that were separated from their souls in a single chamber, the severed souls however, were set free.
At first, the severed souls were hopeful. Since they weren't bound, they thought they could leave; however, no matter what they did, nothing worked.

In their soul form, they were completely helpless. They were no different than mere ghosts who couldn't even touch physical matter, and since they couldn't get more than 50 meters away from their bodies, they couldn't leave the world and call for backup either.
They were utterly helpless and in a million-year-long history of Umbrasol, not even a single soul ever escaped the Progenitors' grasp.

The only reason the Umbrasol Progenitors even set them free was to give them a False Hope. It was a method to break them even faster. And it was an extremely effective method. Most souls simply gave up trying after a few decades. After all, what they went through on a daily basis wasn't something a living entity could bear.
It was a torture that could break even the bravest of beings.
At first, when Nux saw it, he was shaken. It was something even worse than the pain of the [Slave Seal]. Even someone like him believed that it was too cruel, but now...
Nux couldn't be more satisfied.
"Oh?"
Suddenly, Nux's eyes fell on the Titan, and he chuckled,
"Three down."
Yes, the Titan's life force had run out.
"You are the only one left, Zyros."

Nux laughed. Zyros didn't listen; he continued to run away. Once again, the limit was reached, and he couldn't move any further, but that didn't stop him. He continued to try, doing everything his mind could think of.
Then suddenly, Nux appeared right in front of him.
"That is enough."
Nux spoke, his hands covered in Death Energy, grabbing Zyros's neck.
Normally, this wasn't possible since one's soul simply passes through physical matter, but the Death Energy was one of the few energies that could interact with it.
"You want to know another interesting fact?"
Suddenly, Nux questioned as a small pin appeared in his hand, which had now healed completely.
"A soul is 100,000 times more sensitive than a physical body.
Do you know what that means?"
Nux questioned, his smile turning more and more demonic.
Zyros's eyes widened in fright.
"It means that if I pierce your soul with this pin, the pain you will feel will be amplified to a degree you didn't even know was possible.
So much pain that normally, your brain would shut itself off to protect your body from this unnatural torture.
But..."
Nux paused, his face distorting as he saw Zyros's expression.
"Yes, since your soul doesn't have a brain, there is no protection mechanism that can help you.
From the start to the moment I am finished,
You will be awake. You will feel every second of the torture I am going to inflict on you for daring to hurt my Vyriana."
Nux's voice turned demonic as he covered the pin with Death Energy and moved it close to Zyros.
Frightened, Zyros tried to move. However, he was just a mere soul with no physical power whatsoever. No matter how he struggled, his limbs simply passed through Nux's body, doing nothing.
In the end, Nux brought the pin next to Zyros's forehead. His resistance became stronger, but again, it was all fruitless...
And then,
"AAAAAAAGGGGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!"
Zyros screamed in agony as the pin very, very slowly pierced through his forehead.
The pin was barely 10 cm long; however, Nux took a good 5 minutes to inject the entire thing into Zyros's forehead, making sure the process was as painful as possible.

All this while, Zyros's screams never stopped. If he were in his body, he would have passed out more than a few times. In his soul form, however, he could only feel the agonizing pain while being fully conscious.
This was the reason Soul Severance was so feared.
Once an entity was captured, escaping was not an option. Only agonizing pain welcomed them, and this pain continued until their soul broke into countless pieces, returning to the universe.
It was the cruellest and one of the worst ways to die in the entire universe.
Something that made even the strongest cultivators shiver just at the thought of it.
"Haaahhh... Haaahhh.... Haaahh..."

After the torture, Zyros's breathing turned heavy. In his state, he didn't even have to breathe. It was just one of the ways to momentarily divert his mind and not recall what he had just gone through.
"You didn't think this was over, did you?"
Of course, Nux wasn't planning on letting him forget it either.
The ring on his finger shined brightly, and suddenly,
Tens of thousands of similar pins fell on the ground, and Nux's smile widened.
Zyros's eyes widened.
"NO- PLEASE NO-
AAAAAAAAAGGGGGGGGGHHHHHHHHHHH!!!"
He wasn't even allowed to plead for mercy as Nux pierced another pin into his forehead, and of course, he made sure he did it as slowly as possible.
"As I said, this will take a long time~
After all,
My right eye still hasn't regenerated completely. I cannot leave in this condition, or my wives would worry about me.
So, till I am completely healed, it is only me and you here."
Nux chuckled, his golden eyes shining with a cold glint.
"Yes, you can blame yourself for hurting me to this extent.
See? Even after so much time had passed, I still haven't regenerated back to full health.
How cruel of you~"
Nux complained, and as he did,
"AAAGGGGGGGGGGHHHHHH!!!"
Zyros continued to scream.

paragraphs: "Is she alright...?"
Nux questioned as he entered his Universe with a worried look on his face.
"She is out of danger,"
Evane replied.
Nux stared at her and she started explaining,
"She is not bleeding anymore. Her Life Force, that was dwindling, has stabilized now. It's a good sign."
Evane replied, but Nux could sense her hesitation.
"But?"
He tilted his head.
Evane bit her lips and said,

"Her body isn't regenerating. I tried to heal her, but some foreign energy is stopping me from doing so. In most cases, my energy usually overpowers such energies, but this time... it isn't working..."
The Elf answered, and Nux realized it.
Evane was facing the same problem he did.
Zyros's Energy must be stopping her from healing Vyriana, and since that energy belonged to a Primordial and was a phase higher, Evane had no way to get rid of it.
A Sovereign Stage Healer couldn't heal the injury inflicted by a Primordial.
The very fact that Evane was able to stabilize Vyriana's Life Force showed how exceptional she was.
"Where is she?"
Nux questioned.
Evane was silent.
Honestly, right now, she wanted to keep Nux away from Vyriana; however, she knew that was impossible.
In the end, she took him to a room, and the moment Nux walked in, he froze.
Inside, Vyriana lay on a bed without her arms. Her face had somewhat healed, but Nux could still see bruises all over her face.
Evane lightly grabbed Nux's hand, trying to calm him down.
"Can you heal her?"
Nux questioned directly.
"I can, but I need time."
"How much?"
"A few months. That energy is too strong. It would be better to have a stronger Healer take a look."
Evane answered honestly. Despite feeling down that she wasn't able to heal her sister, she didn't let those thoughts cloud her judgment.
"I understand."
Nux nodded as he then turned around, walking out of the room.
Evane called out with an uncertain look on her face.
"We are going back to Yrniel."
Nux declared before he walked out, leaving Evane with Vyriana.
"You took longer than I expected."
Suddenly, Nux heard a voice.
He turned around and saw Amaya walking towards him with a solemn expression on her face.
"So the enemies were strong, huh..."
She understood.
"That was no—"
"Nux, you blocked our vision and stopped us from witnessing the battle.
Vyriana was hurt, yet you still needed an hour to come and check on her, and,"
Suddenly, Amaya narrowed her eyes as she walked towards Nux.
She placed her hand on Nux's right cheek and then,
"Your right eye is trembling.
You were hurt."
It wasn't hard for Amaya to deduce what happened.
"You were waiting for your injuries to heal before coming here."
"It was nothing serious," Nux answered.
"If that was the case, you would have come sooner.
And stop lying, I can feel your emotions, not to mention you are a terrible liar."
Nux just turned silent.
"Are we going back to Yrniel?"
Amaya questioned.
Nux nodded, and the devourer nodded back.
The next instant, Nux opened a portal to Yrniel.
The Core was still connected to ExceedoGenesis's base in Yrniel; Nux and the others could return to Yrniel anytime they wanted.
Nux exited the portal. He would have met Royce and the others if it was a normal situation, but it wasn't.
He quickly teleported to High Order, inside Aeliana's office.
"INTRUDE—"
Sensing a foreign presence inside, all the guards rushed in at the same time.

These guards were a few of the strongest beings in the Order, the mightiest Divine Stage Cultivators with strong Laws; however, as they tried to rush at Nux, they lost control over their bodies mid-air, and they floated helplessly, unable to move while the 'enemy' stood right in front of them.
"N-Nux Leander..."
They recognized who he was.
"Since you know who I am, don't come in again."
Nux replied, sending all five guards back where they came from.
Once again, the office was empty, with the only people inside being Nux and... his 'master.'
"You come to see me after all this time, and even now, it's only because you want something from me. How selfish of you."
Aeliana complained.
Initially, she was glad that Nux came to her. However, the moment she noticed his expression, she realized that he needed help.

Of course, it wasn't like she didn't wish to help him—quite the opposite, she was glad he came to her—but for some reason, she still felt disappointed that Nux came to her not because he wanted to, but because he needed her help.
"Vyriana is hurt."
Nux replied, his tone completely opposite to Aeliana's playful tone, and the next instant, the smile on Aeliana's face disappeared.
"What...?"
"She was attacked by a Primordial an—"
"Why the hell were you people messing with Primordials!?"
Aeliana screamed in anger.
"It was my mistake. I didn't think it through."
Nux admitted.
Aeliana paused. Then, just like Amaya, she narrowed her eyes as well.
The Vampire then turned into Blood Mist and reformed her body in front of Nux, her hand holding his face as she observed him closely.
Her speed was so fast that, despite being able to see her, Nux's body couldn't react at all.
Once again, Nux realized just what sort of monster stood in front of him.
If instead of those five Primordials, he was facing her instead, Nux was certain that he would have never come out victorious, especially in the state he was currently in.
Even now, when his control over his body was somewhat better, enough to allow him to defeat four Primordials at the same time, he still didn't think he was strong enough to take on this woman.
"You were hurt,"
Aeliana commented.
"Your right eye was disintegrated."
'How the hell do these two know about it? Have they developed some sort of technique to keep an eye on me all the time?'
Honestly, considering their personalities, Nux wouldn't be surprised if that was the case.
"Who did you fight, and where are they now?"
Aeliana questioned as she narrowed her eyes dangerously.

chapters.title: Chapter 1776 Who said we escaped?
paragraphs: "Who did you fight, and where are they now?"
Aeliana questioned as she narrowed her eyes dangerously.
"Twat iwsn't impotwant rwight now."
Nux couldn't say it clearly since the Vampire was holding his face in a way that her fingers were pressing both his cheeks inward, making it difficult for him to speak.
Seeing him struggle, Aeliana stepped back, releasing him.
"We need to heal Vyriana first."
Nux spoke with a solemn look on his face.
Aeliana nodded as she then grabbed Nux's hand and flew out of her office, her speed so fast that everything around looked like a blur.
Within a few seconds, the two appeared in front of a cottage. Nux needed a moment to regain his balance. Once he was ready, the two walked in.
"Why are you two here?"
Nux's eyes fell on an extremely beautiful woman, a woman he had seen before.
One of the six Elven Progenitors, Sylvara Origin.
The Elven Progenitor smiled playfully as she nodded at him. Nux's mind was currently wrapped around his Vyriana, and he didn't react.
"Nux."
Aeliana called out.
Nux nodded, understanding her signal. A portal opened next to him, and Evane, who was carrying Vyriana in her arms, walked out.
The moment she appeared, the room turned deathly silent.
This time, it wasn't just Nux; a cold, menacing look appeared on Aeliana's face as she saw her friend's condition.
Evane's body trembled. She quickly walked towards the Elven Progenitor, and suddenly, the Dragon's body started floating in the air.
Evane or others didn't resist. They knew it was the Progenitor's doing.
Vyriana was then enveloped in golden light, and the next second, Nux and the others could see her flesh move.

Her face, that was bruised, was healed instantly, next were her arms. While Evane was only able to stop the bleeding, under the Progenitor's care, Vyriana's arms started regrowing. The energy that had been preventing Evane from healing the Dragon was dissipated into oblivion, and within a minute,
Vyriana was back to full health.
"Lady Sylvara, please heal him as well."
Aeliana suddenly pointed at Nux.
Nux frowned. Sylvara observed Nux, and suddenly, a warm golden energy enveloped Nux as well.
In an instant, whatever internal injuries that hadn't healed yet, healed, and Nux was back to full health as well.
"Why would you people go against Primordials? You should consider yourself lucky that you were able to escape despite challenging multiple Primordials at the same time.
Who told you to be so reckless?"
Sylvara spoke with a frown on her face.
Even though she healed the two back to full health, she didn't appreciate them moving recklessly like this.

Honestly, she didn't have any personal relationship with any of them. However, she knew that the Dragon was her friend's treasured disciple. She also knew that Aeliana seemed to care about these two quite a lot, and the last thing she wanted was to see Aeliana get hurt because of their foolish actions.
After all, Aeliana was like a daughter to her.
"They fought... multiple Primordials...?"
Aeliana, who heard Sylvara's words, questioned as she stared at Nux with an icy look on her face.
Nux's body trembled as he saw her expression.
The Elven Progenitor, however, didn't help him.
"The Dragon only faced one, but when I healed him, I sensed the energies of at least four Primordials inside his body. There could be more, but I am not very sure."
"Four...?"
Aeliana tilted her head, her crimson eyes staring at Nux.
Gulp
Nux gulped as he stepped back.
Even though he was strong enough to face four Primordials, this woman was still too intimidating for him.
"Nux Leander."
Aeliana called out.
"Y-Yes?"
"We need to talk."
Aeliana walked towards Nux and grabbed his hand again.
"Wait, I need to stay he-"
"Vyriana will be under Lady Sylvara's care, and you are coming with me."
The moment she said those words, Aeliana flew out, dragging Nux with her.
Silence fell over Sylvara's cottage.
"What about me...?"
Evane, who was left alone, didn't know how to react.
She couldn't access [Core] in this place, neither could she be pulled into Nux's Universe
since only Shadow or Nux could do that, and both weren't here.
For now, the Elf was stuck together with the Elven Progenitor.
"What were you guys even thinking?"
Sylvara questioned with a frown on her face. She could tell that her little Aeliana was angry, and she didn't like it.
At the same time, she also wanted to know what gave these people the gall to actually
try and go against Primordials.
"Was it a tournament of some sort?"
She questioned. Soon, however, she shook her head.
Despite not having explored the Universe much, she knew no one would be foolish
enough to hold a tournament where a Divine faces a Primordial.
The only logical explanation here would be that,
"Did they ambush you?"
"Something like that..."
Evane nodded, and Sylvara's expression changed.
"Did you do anything to offend them?"
"One of their members wanted us to join their party..."
Evane answered, and Sylvara could guess the rest of the story.
The Progenitor wasn't a fool. She could see how good-looking these women were. They would attract attention wherever they went, and it wasn't like she wasn't familiar with
these people. She could guess what their answer was when they were asked to join their
party.
Especially this Dragon's. Sylvara had heard of what kind of terrifying presence this
Dragon had in the Order. She knew what sort of personality this woman had.
The only difference was...
That in the Order, the Dragon had her Master protecting her, but in Outer Space...
That card didn't work anymore.
"You should be more careful. The Universe is anything but safe. You need to keep your
guard up all the time.
You were lucky that you were able to escape this time, but don't rely on your luck all the
time.
Also, do not go back to whatever Mercenary World you were in. Those bastards might
still be on the lookout for you.
Go to some other Mercenary World, possibly a World far away from the previous one."
Sylvara suggested, but Evane just tilted her head in confusion.
"Who said we escaped?"

Aeliana questioned as she narrowed her eyes dangerously.
"Twat iwsn't impotwant rwight now."
Nux couldn't say it clearly since the Vampire was holding his face in a way that her fingers were pressing both his cheeks inward, making it difficult for him to speak.
Seeing him struggle, Aeliana stepped back, releasing him.
"We need to heal Vyriana first."
Nux spoke with a solemn look on his face.
Aeliana nodded as she then grabbed Nux's hand and flew out of her office, her speed so fast that everything around looked like a blur.
Within a few seconds, the two appeared in front of a cottage.
Nux needed a moment to regain his balance.
Once he was ready, the two walked in.
"Why are you two here?"
Nux's eyes fell on an extremely beautiful woman, a woman he had seen before.
One of the six Elven Progenitors, Sylvara Origin.
The Elven Progenitor smiled playfully as she nodded at him.
Nux's mind was currently wrapped around his Vyriana, and he didn't react.
"Nux."
Aeliana called out.
Nux nodded, understanding her signal.
A portal opened next to him, and Evane, who was carrying Vyriana in her arms, walked out.
The moment she appeared, the room turned deathly silent.
This time, it wasn't just Nux; a cold, menacing look appeared on Aeliana's face as she saw her friend's condition.
Evane's body trembled.
She quickly walked towards the Elven Progenitor, and suddenly, the Dragon's body started floating in the air.
Evane or others didn't resist.
They knew it was the Progenitor's doing.
Vyriana was then enveloped in golden light, and the next second, Nux and the others could see her flesh move.
Her face, that was bruised, was healed instantly, next were her arms.
While Evane was only able to stop the bleeding, under the Progenitor's care, Vyriana's arms started regrowing.
The energy that had been preventing Evane from healing the Dragon was dissipated into oblivion, and within a minute,
Vyriana was back to full health.
"Lady Sylvara, please heal him as well."
Aeliana suddenly pointed at Nux.
Nux frowned.
Sylvara observed Nux, and suddenly, a warm golden energy enveloped Nux as well.
In an instant, whatever internal injuries that hadn't healed yet, healed, and Nux was back to full health as well.
"Why would you people go against Primordials?
You should consider yourself lucky that you were able to escape despite challenging multiple Primordials at the same time.
Who told you to be so reckless?"
Sylvara spoke with a frown on her face.
Even though she healed the two back to full health, she didn't appreciate them moving recklessly like this.
Honestly, she didn't have any personal relationship with any of them.
However, she knew that the Dragon was her friend's treasured disciple.
She also knew that Aeliana seemed to care about these two quite a lot, and the last thing she wanted was to see Aeliana get hurt because of their foolish actions.
After all, Aeliana was like a daughter to her.
"They fought... multiple Primordials...?"
Aeliana, who heard Sylvara's words, questioned as she stared at Nux with an icy look on her face.
Nux's body trembled as he saw her expression.
The Elven Progenitor, however, didn't help him.
"The Dragon only faced one, but when I healed him, I sensed the energies of at least four Primordials inside his body.
There could be more, but I am not very sure."
"Four...?"
Aeliana tilted her head, her crimson eyes staring at Nux.
Gulp
Nux gulped as he stepped back.
Even though he was strong enough to face four Primordials, this woman was still too intimidating for him.
"Nux Leander."
Aeliana called out.
"Y-Yes?"
"We need to talk."
Aeliana walked towards Nux and grabbed his hand again.
"Wait, I need to stay he-"
"Vyriana will be under Lady Sylvara's care, and you are coming with me."
The moment she said those words, Aeliana flew out, dragging Nux with her.
Silence fell over Sylvara's cottage.
"What about me...?"
Evane, who was left alone, didn't know how to react.
She couldn't access [Core] in this place, neither could she be pulled into Nux's Universe
since only Shadow or Nux could do that, and both weren't here.
For now, the Elf was stuck together with the Elven Progenitor.
"What were you guys even thinking?"
Sylvara questioned with a frown on her face.
She could tell that her little Aeliana was angry, and she didn't like it.
At the same time, she also wanted to know what gave these people the gall to actually
try and go against Primordials.
"Was it a tournament of some sort?"
She questioned.
Soon, however, she shook her head.
Despite not having explored the Universe much, she knew no one would be foolish
enough to hold a tournament where a Divine faces a Primordial.
The only logical explanation here would be that,
"Did they ambush you?"
"Something like that..."
Evane nodded, and Sylvara's expression changed.
"Did you do anything to offend them?"
"One of their members wanted us to join their party..."
Evane answered, and Sylvara could guess the rest of the story.
The Progenitor wasn't a fool.
She could see how good-looking these women were.
They would attract attention wherever they went, and it wasn't like she wasn't familiar with
these people.
She could guess what their answer was when they were asked to join their
party.
Especially this Dragon's.
Sylvara had heard of what kind of terrifying presence this
Dragon had in the Order.
She knew what sort of personality this woman had.
The only difference was...
That in the Order, the Dragon had her Master protecting her, but in Outer Space...
That card didn't work anymore.
"You should be more careful.
The Universe is anything but safe.
You need to keep your
guard up all the time.
You were lucky that you were able to escape this time, but don't rely on your luck all the
time.
Also, do not go back to whatever Mercenary World you were in.
Those bastards might
still be on the lookout for you.
Go to some other Mercenary World, possibly a World far away from the previous one."
Sylvara suggested, but Evane just tilted her head in confusion.
"Who said we escaped?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1777 Fuck, I fell hard, didn’t I?
paragraphs: "So you are telling me...
You fought against five Primordials... and won...?"
Aeliana, who heard the entire story, couldn't believe what she was hearing.
"Well, I did get rid of one of them with a sneak attack, so it was essentially four, not five."
Nux corrected, and Aeliana just stared at this man in disbelief.
To think she would ever hear a Divine Stage Cultivator say that he defeated five
Primordial Level Cultivators in a battle...
And this man even dared to correct her that he actually killed one of them in one move, so it was 'essentially four, not five.'
Essentially four, her ass!
These were Primordials they were talking about!
Primordials! Cultivators an entire phase above him!

There were barely twenty cultivators at this level in the entirety of the Ancestral Order! If Nux said he took out five of them all on his own, didn't that mean this man had grown enough to take on a fourth of the Order's total strength!?

Yes, Aeliana knew Nux was different, he was used to breaking what was supposed to be the 'standard, and honestly, despite her brain constantly telling her it was impossible, somewhere in her heart, she knew this man would be capable of holding off on his own against a Primordial as a Divine Stage Cultivator.
With the absurdities Nux had performed thus far, she did somewhat expect this...
But...
Holding off on his own and outright defeating Primordials were two different things... Not to mention killing them with one single punch...
This made no sense at all....
Not a single entity should be able to do this...
Not to mention the Primordials he fought were mostly from Middle Level Worlds, and one of them even came from a High Level World! Those Primordials were much stronger than Primordials of Yrniel.
If Nux could take five of them on his own...
Then... doesn't it mean that if he was up against the Primordials of Yrniel, he could probably face more...?
Just thinking of that sight made Aeliana lose her mind, and Nux, who could read her mind like an open book, just chuckled,
"Hehe- You are greatly underestimating the student you taught, Aeliana~"
Aeliana, however, didn't like his reaction and glared at him with piercing cold eyes. Once again, she grabbed the poor man's face, her fingers sinking into his cheeks, and,
"You dare act cheeky when you came back all battered up!?"
"What if something happened to you!?
Luckily, that man attacked Vyriana, who stood next to you, but what if he had targeted someone else!?
What would you have done then!?

You come out and, despite knowing that you have next to no control over your body, you dare to lure the enemy, that you know are much stronger than anyone you have faced thus far, into a secluded, empty world, giving them a perfect opportunity to ambush you, and you did it just because that fool was eyeing your wives!?
You had thousands of ways to kill that man without having to get involved with the Primordials, didn't you!?
Why didn't you use that!? Why did you risk yours and your wives' lives!?
What were you thinking!?"
Aeliana shouted, her crimson eyes glimmering in rage and... fear. Tears threatened to fall out of her eyes, but before they could, the Vampire wiped them out of existence.
Nux didn't know what to say.
Why did he do it?

It was because he wanted to test his strength against the Primordials. He had spent millions of years watching Umbrasol's history. In the eyes of a High Level World, Primordials were never a big deal, and Nux's thoughts were influenced by that thinking. Even for him, the Primordials were not a big deal...
Well... that is when he is inside his Universe. Outside, Primordials were still a threat. A threat he couldn't take lightly, and his battle with the Primordials proved it.
For the major chunk of the battle, he was losing.
Yes, those Primordials could never kill him because he could simply enter his Universe if he was overwhelmed, but...
Nux, out of all the people, should know that these beings were anything but simple.
Sure, he could escape whenever he wanted to...
But what if he wasn't even given a chance to escape in the first place?
What if beings at this level decided to attack him sneakily?
What if... these beings decided to target his wives instead...?
Nux also knew that it wasn't entirely impossible for some of these beings to stop him from entering his Universe. Nux knew there were beings out there capable of doing this.
He should have been more careful.
He should have paid more attention.
"I... I wwas wrwong"
He apologized.
Aeliana, however, wasn't going to leave the matter.
"I have decided."
She suddenly spoke as she released Nux's face.
"From now on, you are going to stay with me."
"W-What...?"
Nux was taken aback.
"I wanted you to go out and explore the Universe, but I should have expected a reckless
man like you to do something like this.
It was my mistake.
You were hurt because I didn't think things through, so from now on,
You are not leaving"
"But the War-"
"It doesn't matter.
I cannot leave you alone."
Aeliana replied, her eyes staring at Nux as if he were her possession.
"You will not leave me, not until you can defeat me."
"But tha-"
"What? You took down five Primordials on your own, didn't you?
This shouldn't be hard enough for you, no?"
Aeliana said with a smile.
That smile, however, sent shivers down Nux's spine.
It... it was a look he had seen before...
Those eyes...
Those eyes were a combination of Vyriana's craziness, Amaya's possessiveness, and
Astaria's battle intent.
Gulp
Nux gulped. Seeing the Vampire looking at him with those eyes, he was intimidated.
It was a normal reaction, and Nux would be perfectly fine if that was all he felt when he
stared at the Vampire.
But....
What freaked him out was the fact that more than being intimidated...
Those eyes...
They turned him on.
'Fuck, I fell hard, didn't I?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1778 You were probably never strong enough for it.
paragraphs: "So you want me to stay with you until I am strong enough to defeat you?"
Nux questioned.
"Yes."
"And I have no say in this matter?"
"Yes, you do not."
Aeliana nodded, her tone made it clear that 'no' wasn't an option.
"You know that I need to join the War so I can devour mo-"
"Yes, yes, whatever you wish to do, it can be done once you are strong enough to defeat me"
"Do you think I won't be reckless anymore once I am strong enough to defeat you?"
"I do not. Recklessness is one of your traits, I doubt you would ever not be reckless.
I just know that once you are stronger than me, I wouldn't be able to stop you even if I tried to, but right now,
I can do that, so I will."
"So what you are saying is....
You are going to use the fact that you are stronger than me to your advantage and force me to stay here with you, right?"
"That is correct."
Aeliana didn't deny those words, no matter how suspicious they sounded.
"Don't you think that is quite unreasonable?"
"Your entire existence
unreasonable.
Do you see me complaining?"
"I do, quite a lot actually."
"Then you can complain as well."
Acliana just shrugged.
The meaning behind her words was clear,
Complain all you want, you aren't leaving.
'Fuck.'
Nux cursed in his mind.
His eyes shamelessly stared at the woman in front of him.
"What are you looking at?"
Aeliana narrowed her eyes.
"Nothing, I just didn't think you were this shameless."
Nux answered.
Hearing those words, Aeliana just chuckled,
"Didn't you say you knew everything about me? Why do you seem surprised?"
"This isn't the Aeliana I knew about."
Nux was honest.
Aeliana right now and Aeliana inside the illusion were indeed different, quite a lot actually.
This Aeliana...
She was much more confident and... bold.
"I guess you didn't know everything about me then."
Aeliana chuckled.
"No, I did know everything about you.
You just developed a new side that I do not know about."
"And what are you going to do about it?"
Aeliana questioned, and Nux started walking towards the Vampire, his possessiveness could no longer be hidden.
Aeliana stared at Nux, not backing down.
She didn't show it on her face, but Nux didn't have to read her expression to know what she was thinking.
The Vampire was looking forward to whatever Nux was going to do.
Yes, the Vampire was willing to play a dangerous game, a game where Nux's track record was off the charts.
Nux's grin widened, he moved dangerously close to the Vampire, so close that he could feel her breath on his neck.
Aeliana was around 10 cm shorter than Nux, so as the two stood right next to each other, her forehead reached Nux's lips, however, this didn't stop Aeliana from looking right into Nux's eyes.
Her crimson eyes were almost hypnotizing.
Then suddenly,
Nux grabbed the woman and pulled her close to him.
"What am I going to do about it?
Nothing."
Nux whispered, his voice so seductive that Aeliana's legs turned weak.
This was the first time she had come so close to Nux, or any man in general. It was a very foreign feeling, something that made her heart race uncontrollably.
Nux, however, started rubbing her back and, in an instant, Aeliana's heart calmed down.
It was a strange feeling, the same man was responsible for making her heart race and calm it down, the Vampire didn't know how to react.
It was then,
"I won't do anything.
I just do not like that there is a side of you that I do not know about.
So during the time you keep me here with you,
I am going to explore that side in every, possible, way, I, can.
And when I am done,
Nothing, and I repeat, nothing, will remain hidden from me."
Nux spoke, his golden eyes glimmering with extreme possessiveness, his grip around
Aeliana strengthened, pulling her even closer to him.
Her ample breasts rested on his chest, and through that touch, Nux could feel her heart
beating quickly.
All this time, Aeliana never moved her eyes away from Nux, not even for a single instant.
"You talk as if you are going to get the time to focus on such things."
Aeliana chuckled lightly, then suddenly,
BOOOOM
Her energy burst out, sending Nux flying.
In an instant, all the 'control' Nux had on the situation disappeared.
Nux's body reacted in an instant, he regained his balance and stood up, his head turning towards Aeliana, but he soon narrowed his eyes when he realized she wasn't there.
His senses expanded, trying to see where the woman was.
"Nux Leander, you are severely underestimating what is going to happen to you from
now on."
Suddenly, Nux heard a voice.
"You dreaded Vyriana's training at one point, did you not?"
The Vampire questioned.
"I'll make it so that you would love Vyriana's training starting today."
Aeliana's body suddenly materialized behind Nux, he reacted and turned around, his
movements, however, were too slow and,
BOOOM
Once again, he was sent flying.
Aeliana wasn't as strong as the Titan or the Ironfang Nux faced before, but that didn't
help Nux at all, as the moment he tried to balance his body and stand again,
BOOOM
The woman materialized in front of him again and pushed him to the ground.
"Ughhh!"
Nux groaned in pain, the ground beneath him cracked.
Even in this situation, the smile on his face didn't fade, he sat up and,
"I would love to see what you have to offer, Aeliana Ruinous. Don't forget, this won't be
the first time you will be teaching m-"
BOOOM
But before he could complete, he was attacked again.
"You don't have to worry about that.
I assure you that you haven't even seen half of what I am capable of.
After all,
You were probably never strong enough for it."
Acliana's voice echoed through Nux's cars, and once again, he had no clue where the
Vampire actually was.
Training with the Vampire had officially started.

chapters.title: Chapter 1779 Aeliana’s Strength.
paragraphs: "You don't have to worry about that,
I assure you that you haven't even seen half of what I am capable of.
After all,
You were probably never strong enough for it."
Those were some confident words.
After all, Nux had spent a million years inside the Illusion; he had interacted with Aeliana so many times, almost anything was possible.
They were close, extremely close. It was to the point Nux knew everything there was to know about Aeliana.
Their bond inside the Illusion was special, so claiming that Nux hadn't even seen half of her true strength without actually knowing what transpired inside the illusion was bold, almost foolish even.
However, Nux, who was on the receiving end of Aeliana's attacks, could tell that the woman wasn't wrong.
Yes, Aeliana inside the illusion had shown him all her abilities, which made him think that he knew the extent of this woman's power.
He, however, was sorely mistaken.
He only saw those abilities....
He never experienced them. Even if he did, it was an extremely weakened version because Aeliana held back.
Now, however, things were different.
This was the first time Nux actually stood against Aeliana, and only now did he understand how much he had underestimated this woman.
One look was all it took for the Vampire to find out his biggest weakness.
His out-of-sync body.
And from the start, all her attacks, despite not doing much damage, had been targeting that weakness.
The woman turned into invisible mist, forcing him to use his senses to find where she was. However, the time took him to do all of this was enough for her to get close to him and attack.

Even if, a few times, he did get lucky and blocked one of her attacks, her body instantly disappeared, and she attacked again, this time even quicker than before. Every time Nux tried to counterattack, his fists just met air and Aeliana had long moved away.
It was as if he was fighting a ghost.
A ghost who was pummeling him without stopping.
Nux felt like a child being toyed with by an extremely powerful opponent.

It was as if everything he had learned so far, his battles with Vyriana where he trained without his limbs, fights where he let the Zenith Flow work at its full potential and let his body move on its own, countless abilities he had, and multiple laws he had mastered... Everything felt useless.
The opponent was simply too tricky.
None of his abilities worked because none of them could hit the target. Aeliana moved away before he could even activate his ability.

Usually, one would tackle a Vampire's ability to turn themselves into Mist by spreading their Mana all around them. The Mist, which doesn't have any physical form or strength, gets trapped inside the Mana barrier, essentially trapping the Vampire. However, when Nux tried that, he couldn't sense any mist around him at all.
It was just so instantaneous.
The moment he could sense the mist and tried to control the mana, he was attacked, and the mist moved away. It was simply too fast for him to be able to do anything.
Even if he teleported away, giving himself some time to prepare, the same thing repeated itself the moment Aeliana approached him.
He was utterly helpless.
BOOM
"Ugghhh!!"
Nux groaned as he was thrown to the ground again.
He wasn't in pain. He was already used to so much pain that little bruises didn't matter. He didn't even scream when his eye disintegrated, so collapsing on the ground was not a big deal.
What made him groan was the frustration.
Even after 5 minutes had passed, he had not been able to successfully land an attack on Aeliana even once.
What made it even worse was the fact that Nux knew the woman was holding back. Every time she attacked him, she held back so he wouldn't be hurt. Otherwise, he
wouldn't have even lasted this long.
"Don't tell me you are tired already."
Seeing that he wasn't moving, Acliana materialized herself next to him with a frown on
her face.
"How are you doing that?"
Nux questioned, his frustration visible on his face.
"Doing what?"
"Moving around like that. Your speed does not match any other Primordials I have seen before."
This statement only became stronger since it came from someone like Nux, who had seen a great number of Primordials in action.
"Did you forget? The Mist abilities increase a Vampire's speed."
Aeliana frowned.
"But that only doubles the speed. Yours is... much faster."
Nux, of course, knew that.
In their mist form, Vampires were one of the fastest beings in the entire Universe.

Of course, there were still hundreds of races faster than them. Not to mention, unlike Vampires, these races don't lose their physical strength and other abilities in exchange for being that fast. However, the fact of the matter is...
The Vampires, in their mist form, were extremely fast.
But...
This woman...
She was just on an entirely different level!
"Well, I do use my Law to make myself a bit faster than others."
"A bit...?"
Nux raised his eyebrows.
"About a 100 times faster than a normal Vampire."
Aeliana nodded with a shrug.
Nux was baffled.
He looked around, as if trying to find someone.
Where were his wives...?
Didn't they always call him a monster and give him a look every time he mentioned
something absurd?
Then what about this woman!?
Does anyone not see how absurd what she said was!?
100 times faster than a normal Vampire!? A race that is already one of the fastest!?
Doesn't that make her the fastest Primordial in the entire Universe and that too by an
absurdly large margin!?
How does she say that with a straight face?
No wait, before that, how is she even doing that?
Nux stared at the woman, and as if knowing what he wanted to ask, she answered,
"I use my Law to control my Mist form.
Since the Mist Form doesn't have any physical weight and doesn't face any resistance, I take control over it using my Law and move it as fast as I want.
So, in theory, my speed can be unlimited, but the more I increase my speed, the more
difficult it becomes for me to control myself and process everything around me, so I
need to limit it to whatever I can control."
"So what you are saying is...
That you can be as fast as your thoughts allow you to be...?"
"Yes."
Aeliana nodded again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1780 A perfect couple.
paragraphs: "So you are saying is...
That you can be as fast as your thoughts allow you to be...?"
"Yes."
Aeliana nodded again.
Nux, however, couldn't believe what he was hearing and asked even more questions.
"So you can be as fast as a Transcendent level being if you just think about it?"
"In my Mist form, yes."
Once again, the woman nodded.
"What about an Eternal?"
"I have never seen an Eternal.
Though I did race with my father once."
"And what were the results...?"
"I lost."
Aeliana replied.
For a moment, Nux froze before he cleared his head.
Yes, what the hell was he even thinking asking that question.
That monster was the strongest being in the entire Universe, an Infinity Level Being. Obviously, he would win. Rather,
"What gave you the confidence to challenge him in the first place?"
Nux couldn't help but question.
"I thought I could defeat him."
Aeliana answered.
"And why is that?"

"I can move as fast as my mind allows me to, so if I have a 'reference' in my head that is moving ahead of me, then in theory, I can follow him at the same speed and even surpass them by increasing my speed even further.
Of course, my mind wouldn't be able to process anything in my surroundings, but if it was only a race, in theory, as long as I can see my opponent, I would never lose.
I could then use that moment to try and get used to that speed. It is a form of training that helps me increase my speed even further.
I did the same when I was young. I trained with Progenitors. I raced with them, forced myself to move at their speed, then I forced my mind to get used to that speed in a way
that I can react to everything around me.
That's what made me faster than all Primordials around me."
Nux was silent.
This was something he never knew about.
While Aeliana in the Illusion did tell him that she was faster than other Vampires, he just thought that it was because she had a strong bloodline. He knew she was fast...
But this fast...
He had no clue.
"So you lost to Lord Azriel because...
"I couldn't see him when he moved."
Aeliana shook her head.
"That man didn't hold back, huh..."
Nux snorted.
"No, he did.
He said he would start with a tenth of his speed. I still couldn't see him."
Nux had no words.
"He is now training me at the speed at which I can see him, so I am improving bit by bit, but the progress is slow."
Aeliana spoke, and only now did Nux realize why this woman was hailed as the strongest Primordial in the entire Yrniel.
It wasn't just because of her strong bloodline or Law.
Unlike him, Vyriana, or anyone else for that matter, who relied on their abilities and Laws to get stronger, mastering them to the point where no other could stand against them,
Aeliana not only mastered these two, she even figured out a way to use her Law in a way others couldn't even think of.
She didn't just become strong just because she was supposed to because of her bloodline and Law.
She became strong because of her sheer efforts and creative ways to use whatever she had in her arsenal to surpass others, even beings a Phase above her.
"He says it is because I have already reached the limits of what my mind can process at my current level.
Now, while I can push through my limits by overloading my mind and progressing slowly, a much faster way would be to break through."
Aeliana continued.
"Which isn't possible because of Yrniel's current conditions..."
Nux muttered.
"Even if Yrniel wasn't in this state, breaking through isn't easy,"
"Right...
Yrniel is currently a Low-Level World, I forgot."
Nux nodded as he then sat up on the ground.
Aeliana sat next to him, both of them staring at the red moon in the sky.
"So this is how you were able to hold your own against the Progenitors, huh.
You used your speed."
Nux didn't know this before, but after observing Umbrasol, he did.
The Progenitors were Pseudo Transcendent.
They didn't have a Law, however, their 'energy quality' was a bit shy from being compared to a true Transcendent.
So the Phase difference between Aeliana and the Progenitors remained.
Nux always wondered how the Vampire was able to hold the Progenitors on her own, even if the Progenitors in question were the weaker ones who didn't focus on battles,
But now, his questions were answered.
It was her speed.
Against her ghost-like battle style, it was obvious that even the Progenitors, especially the ones who weren't very used to battles, would have a difficult time.
"I have other techniques as well, but yes, my speed is the main reason I can hold them off for a few days. After that, my mind tires out and I am unable to fight more."
"Doesn't that mean if your mind never tires out, you will never lose to them?"
"Such fantasy-like thoughts are entertaining."
Aeliana chuckled lightly.
Nux chuckled as well, his eyes, however, shimmered intensely.
For Aeliana, these were indeed 'fantasy-like thoughts, but....
What about him?
A Being who has reformed his brain using the energy of a High-Level World.
His mind worked and processed things at a rate normal entities couldn't even fathom...
If he learned Aeliana's ability...
Nux couldn't even imagine what sort of monster he would become.
"What about you?
You still didn't tell me how you won against the Primordials you faced.
You just said your physical strength has risen. You didn't tell how your fight went."
"There is nothing much to tell honestly....
I punched the first one, his body was obliterated.
The second one, I punched him as well, only his feet remained.
The third one, I tore his head off.
The fourth one, I tore his arm off. He killed himself using all his life force.
The fifth one...
Well, he harmed my Vyriana, so he is still alive.
I figured Vyriana might want to talk to him when she wakes up!"
Nux shrugged, then leaned his head on Aeliana's shoulder, making the Vampire
momentarily freeze.
Soon, however, she leaned her head on Nux's head, and a light smile appeared on Nux's
face as he continued.
"Honestly, I only won because I was lucky. If the opponents were stronger, I would have
lost."
He sighed.
And Aeliana just stayed silent, her mouth twitching without stop.
Honestly, these two monsters were perfect for each other.
They would continue to play this 'making the other speechless' game with each other
while the rest of the Universe loses its mind at their feats.
A perfect couple indeed.
