chapters.title: Chapter 1781 Yrniel’s mistakes.
paragraphs: "Honestly, I only won because I was lucky. If the opponents were stronger, I would have lost."
Nux sighed.
Saying these words when the so-called 'weak opponents' were beings who were an entire phase above you, and that too, five of them at the same time, made Aeliana's mouth twitch.
The Vampire, however, didn't say anything.
She knew that going forward, she needed to get used to this man's shamelessness.
"I still cannot believe that you are already strong enough to take on almost half of the Order I created all by yourself,"
Aeliana suddenly commented.
Yes, the woman seemed like she wanted to continue playing their little 'game. This time, Nux's mouth twitched.
Wasn't this woman flexing a little too hard here!?

How could one forget? Together with being this monstrous and being able to face Progenitors, who no one else in the entirety of Yrniel could face, this woman was also the Leader of the Ancestral Order.

This woman not only trained herself to the level she was today, but she also took the responsibility to strengthen the messy Yrniel that always needed the Progenitors' protection, creating an organization and making it strong enough to withstand foreign threats without needing the Progenitors.
An organization so strong that its position in Yrniel was absolute, with no other force having even half the power to oppose it.

So not only was this woman strong enough to surprise even Supreme Level Worlds and most likely hold the title of the strongest Primordial in the entire Universe, but she was also a great leader who could influence masses like no other.
Just the fact that the entire Ancestral Order would happily give their lives away for her sake was enough to tell just how ridiculously good of a leader this woman was.
However,
"The strength of the Ancestral Order is insignificant when seen from a grander scale, Acliana, and you, out of all people, should know that."
Nux spoke.
Yes, the Ancestral Order was strong, but only in Yrniel.
Their forces didn't mean anything to the major forces in the Universe.
Aeliana was talented. Her talents, however, were being wasted here, and Nux could not ignore that.
"You cannot grow the Ancestral Order more than you already have,"
Nux spoke, his head still rested on her shoulder.
Seeing that she didn't move her head away either, he knew she was listening.
"Not everyone is like you, Aeliana.
Not everyone can break the limits imposed by the world they are born in, and even you, despite being the strongest Primordial I have ever encountered, are still being limited by Yrniel as well.
Yrniel cannot be strengthened any further, no matter what you do."
Nux spoke with a serious look on his face.
"Limited energy, huh..."
Aeliana acknowledged the problem.
"Yes.
Yrniel has made too many mistakes.

Making the first protection barrier last so long, recreating the protection barrier, strengthening the Progenitors, forcefully making them Pseudo Transcendents, connecting with Lord Azriel, then Lord Azriel accepting the foxes-there are just too many things to fix. It cannot be done.
Honestly, just the fact that Yrniel has more than 100 Progenitors and so many different. races is a big mistake as well."
Aeliana's expression changed.
This was something she hadn't heard before.
"That's correct."
Nux nodded as he then continued,
"The Progenitors didn't form their Laws when they had the chance to.
It can be said that it was probably because they didn't have enough exposure.
They were still inside the Protection Barrier; they had no clue that a vast universe outside of what they knew existed.
It not only killed their motivation to get stronger, but it also took away one of the most common ways for them to get stronger, which was to meet beings from another world and explore the Universe.
However, this wasn't the only reason behind it.
There was another reason.
And that was the number of Progenitors.

Because Yrniel had too much energy, it gave birth to too many races. Generally, normal worlds had three or maybe four races; some just had one single race. Because of this, those worlds were able to support their people and help them grow. However, Yrniel created too many Progenitors, so it couldn't support all of them.
The Progenitors of Yrniel were weak even when compared to other Progenitors born in worlds with less energy than Yrniel because those worlds had managed their energy
well.
Like Umbrasol.
Umbrasol was only a High-Level World. Compared to Yrniel, an incarnation of a Supreme World that should have around 80% of its energy, it was much weaker.
However, Umbrasol didn't make the mistakes Yrniel did.

It only gave birth to a single race. However, the Progenitors of this race were so gifted that despite Umbrasol's Protection Barrier being higher than what was considered normal, the Umbrasol Progenitors figured out a way to form their Laws on their own and even made further breakthroughs.

By the time their Protection Barrier disappeared, they were already Transcendent Level Beings, and unlike our Progenitors, who were pushed by Yrniel, those beings were True Transcendents with strong laws."
This time, Aeliana moved her head from Nux's head to look into the man's eyes.
The question she had in her mind couldn't be more obvious, and Nux nodded.
"Yes, beings in Umbrasol didn't 'devour' other worlds to understand their law structures
and whatnot.
They didn't need any external help.
They were gifted enough to understand and explore their Laws on their own, using their
own ways."
"So we..."
"People of Yrniel had no choice but to rely on external help because our potential is
weak.
Generally, the method of devouring worlds to strengthen one's understanding of Laws is looked down upon in the Universe.

Well, for the Low or Lowest Level Worlds that you have interacted with thus far, it may be different. But for the level above them, it is believed that if you need to devour Worlds in order to understand your own Law and breakthrough, then you weren't
supposed to break through in the first place.
They believe that it is a shortcut that restricts a being's ability to explore and comprehend things on their own.
It is considered to be a slow poison as it is said to produce 'incompetent cultivators.
It is also considered wasteful since you are sacrificing an entire world just to get a slight glimpse of its law structure, instead of ruling that world as its God instead."

sentences.text: "Honestly, I only won because I was lucky.
If the opponents were stronger, I would have lost."
Nux sighed.
Saying these words when the so-called 'weak opponents' were beings who were an entire phase above you, and that too, five of them at the same time, made Aeliana's mouth twitch.
The Vampire, however, didn't say anything.
She knew that going forward, she needed to get used to this man's shamelessness.
"I still cannot believe that you are already strong enough to take on almost half of the Order I created all by yourself,"
Aeliana suddenly commented.
Yes, the woman seemed like she wanted to continue playing their little 'game.
This time, Nux's mouth twitched.
Wasn't this woman flexing a little too hard here!?
How could one forget?
Together with being this monstrous and being able to face Progenitors, who no one else in the entirety of Yrniel could face, this woman was also the Leader of the Ancestral Order.

This woman not only trained herself to the level she was today, but she also took the responsibility to strengthen the messy Yrniel that always needed the Progenitors' protection, creating an organization and making it strong enough to withstand foreign threats without needing the Progenitors.
An organization so strong that its position in Yrniel was absolute, with no other force having even half the power to oppose it.

So not only was this woman strong enough to surprise even Supreme Level Worlds and most likely hold the title of the strongest Primordial in the entire Universe, but she was also a great leader who could influence masses like no other.
Just the fact that the entire Ancestral Order would happily give their lives away for her sake was enough to tell just how ridiculously good of a leader this woman was.
However,
"The strength of the Ancestral Order is insignificant when seen from a grander scale, Acliana, and you, out of all people, should know that."
Nux spoke.
Yes, the Ancestral Order was strong, but only in Yrniel.
Their forces didn't mean anything to the major forces in the Universe.
Aeliana was talented.
Her talents, however, were being wasted here, and Nux could not ignore that.
"You cannot grow the Ancestral Order more than you already have,"
Nux spoke, his head still rested on her shoulder.
Seeing that she didn't move her head away either, he knew she was listening.
"Not everyone is like you, Aeliana.
Not everyone can break the limits imposed by the world they are born in, and even you, despite being the strongest Primordial I have ever encountered, are still being limited by Yrniel as well.
Yrniel cannot be strengthened any further, no matter what you do."
Nux spoke with a serious look on his face.
"Limited energy, huh..."
Aeliana acknowledged the problem.
"Yes.
Yrniel has made too many mistakes.

Making the first protection barrier last so long, recreating the protection barrier, strengthening the Progenitors, forcefully making them Pseudo Transcendents, connecting with Lord Azriel, then Lord Azriel accepting the foxes-there are just too many things to fix.
It cannot be done.
Honestly, just the fact that Yrniel has more than 100 Progenitors and so many different. races is a big mistake as well."
Aeliana's expression changed.
This was something she hadn't heard before.
"That's correct."
Nux nodded as he then continued,
"The Progenitors didn't form their Laws when they had the chance to.
It can be said that it was probably because they didn't have enough exposure.
They were still inside the Protection Barrier; they had no clue that a vast universe outside of what they knew existed.
It not only killed their motivation to get stronger, but it also took away one of the most common ways for them to get stronger, which was to meet beings from another world and explore the Universe.
However, this wasn't the only reason behind it.
There was another reason.
And that was the number of Progenitors.
Because Yrniel had too much energy, it gave birth to too many races.
Generally, normal worlds had three or maybe four races; some just had one single race.
Because of this, those worlds were able to support their people and help them grow.
However, Yrniel created too many Progenitors, so it couldn't support all of them.
The Progenitors of Yrniel were weak even when compared to other Progenitors born in worlds with less energy than Yrniel because those worlds had managed their energy
well.
Like Umbrasol.
Umbrasol was only a High-Level World.
Compared to Yrniel, an incarnation of a Supreme World that should have around 80% of its energy, it was much weaker.
However, Umbrasol didn't make the mistakes Yrniel did.
It only gave birth to a single race.

However, the Progenitors of this race were so gifted that despite Umbrasol's Protection Barrier being higher than what was considered normal, the Umbrasol Progenitors figured out a way to form their Laws on their own and even made further breakthroughs.

By the time their Protection Barrier disappeared, they were already Transcendent Level Beings, and unlike our Progenitors, who were pushed by Yrniel, those beings were True Transcendents with strong laws."
This time, Aeliana moved her head from Nux's head to look into the man's eyes.
The question she had in her mind couldn't be more obvious, and Nux nodded.
"Yes, beings in Umbrasol didn't 'devour' other worlds to understand their law structures
and whatnot.
They didn't need any external help.
They were gifted enough to understand and explore their Laws on their own, using their
own ways."
"So we..."
"People of Yrniel had no choice but to rely on external help because our potential is
weak.
Generally, the method of devouring worlds to strengthen one's understanding of Laws is looked down upon in the Universe.
Well, for the Low or Lowest Level Worlds that you have interacted with thus far, it may be different.
But for the level above them, it is believed that if you need to devour Worlds in order to understand your own Law and breakthrough, then you weren't
supposed to break through in the first place.
They believe that it is a shortcut that restricts a being's ability to explore and comprehend things on their own.
It is considered to be a slow poison as it is said to produce 'incompetent cultivators.
It is also considered wasteful since you are sacrificing an entire world just to get a slight glimpse of its law structure, instead of ruling that world as its God instead."

chapters.title: Chapter 1782 Only focus on me.
paragraphs: Aeliana was silent, absorbing everything Nux told her.
"To think even father doesn't know this..."
"He knows."
Nux smiled wryly.
"What...?"
Aeliana frowned.

"The deeper you explore your law, the closer you get to the Universe, and the more of its secrets you unveil. A Primordial obviously understands the Universe better than a Divine. The same is true for a Transcendent knowing more than a Primordial and an Eternal knowing more than a Transcendent.
Lord Azriel is an Infinity-Level Being. The things he knows, we probably cannot even comprehend, even if we wish to.
Something as basic as this shouldn't be a secret for him. It is just not possible."
Nux shook his head.
"Then why would he keep it a secret from us? He has no reason to do so."
Aeliana couldn't understand.
Nux, however, just chuckled,
"What reason does he have to reveal all this?
He already knows the people of Yrniel have weaker potential, but what is he supposed to do? Tell them about their inferiority and about how other beings around the Universe have it easy?
Or...
Just let them believe that this is how the entire Universe functions and that it is no big deal.

Don't forget, you were born in Yrniel as well, but despite that, you are the strongest Primordial I have seen. Even if I cannot confirm that you are the strongest, I can confidently say you are indeed one of the strongest Primordials in the entire Universe. Do you think you would have reached that level if you were told that your race is weaker than tens of thousands of different races out in the Universe?
Maybe, or maybe not. It is hard to say, but all in all, it didn't matter.
He didn't say anything because he knew there was nothing he could do about it."
"It must have been hard, living while keeping secrets from people he is close to."
Aeliana muttered.
"He should be used to it by now."
Nux replied, his golden eyes shining with a mysterious glow,
"You seem to understand that feeling"
Aeliana commented as she stared right at. Nux's face.
Nux momentarily froze, not knowing what to say. Then, he smiled wryly,
"I do possess an entire world's knowledge in my head. Knowledge that I cannot share, even if I want to."
As if realizing something, he tilted his head and,
"I guess I do understand that feeling"
Aeliana stared at Nux in silence.
She was having a hard time believing that this was the same man she had met a few decades ago.
He felt so...
Different...
He felt so...
Mature...
"Knowledge from a High-Level World, huh...'
Aeliana muttered in her head.

The fact that Nux possessed such vast knowledge and had rebuilt his brain to completely absorb all that knowledge made her realize just how different this man actually was from the man she had met a few decades ago.
Millions of years of knowledge was inside his head. The very fact that this man hadn't. lost his mind was already surprising.
The lost look she was currently seeing in his eyes was similar to what her father sometimes showed.
"The two are so similar
She realized.
And unlike Nux, who had his wives with him to keep him sane,
Her father had been alone all this time...
The moment this realization sank in, Aeliana's expression changed.
"I still do not understand my father, huh..."
She muttered in a depressing tone.
"Meh, why bother trying to understand an old man anyways?
I am sure you have much better things you can focus on~"
Nux smiled as he gently held Aeliana's hands. He knew what the woman was thinking, but he also knew her line of thought was wasteful.
Azriel...
That man was lonely. And yes, even though he did have his daughter with him, Nux had no doubt in his mind that unlike him, who relied on his wives, that man would never rely
on his daughter.
He would only provide, while facing everything on his own.
A feeling Nux frowned upon but also understood at the same time.

After all, if he ever had children in the future, he would make sure they had the entire Universe in their hands. He would never let those children face any trouble, let alone share his own troubles with them.
The Vampire didn't resist Nux and let him hold her hands. Not just that, a smile appeared
on her face, and she played along,
"Oh? And what are those things you are talking about?"
Maybe even she understood that her father would never let her inside his life
completely.
"Me."
Nux's answer was instantaneous.
He then placed his forehead on the Vampire's and spoke in a heavy, obsessive voice,
"Only focus on me.
That's all you need.
Tunnel vision yourself. See only me and me."
His words rang in Aeliana's ears, as if hypnotizing the woman.
The Vampire closed her eyes, only focusing on Nux's voice. A light smile suddenly
appeared on her face,
"That sounds... so limiting."
She commented.
"It doesn't matter.
I'll make sure you will not regret this for even a single second.
I'll take the responsibility, Aeliana Ruinous."
Aeliana's smile widened. Then suddenly, she moved her forehead away and flicked Nux's
nose.
"Whatever you are doing won't work, Nux Leander."
She replied confidently.
"Is that so..."
Nux smiled, looking down at his hands.
Aeliana looked down, and her expression changed. For some reason, Nux wasn't holding
her hands anymore...
It was her...
She was the one holding his hands...
"When did I...?"
She was confused.
Seeing her expression, Nux's smile widened.
"What I am doing has been working for a long time, Aeliana Ruinous. You have fallen so
deep that escaping isn't even an option."
Aeliana, however, didn't give in.
"Who said I need to escape in the first place?
I can simply conquer." Aeliana then placed her palm on Nux's chest. Nux looked down, waiting to see what she
was going to do.
But then,
BOOOM
He was sent flying, and as his body flew back, he heard a playful voice,
"After all,
You are still weak"

chapters.title: Chapter 1783 Nux was losing his mind!
paragraphs: BOOOM
Nux was sent flying again.
It was a similar pattern again.
After the first surprise attack, Aeliana didn't continue; rather, she allowed Nux to stand up, take his battle stance, and mentally prepare himself. Once he was completely ready,
He was battered up again.
Even now, Nux was helpless. There was a limit to how much his body could adapt. Opponents like Vrakor and others, he could still handle, but a monster like Acliana? There was nothing he could do.
To the onlooker, it would look like, rather than training, it was a one-sided beating- bullying even.
Nux, however, could sense it.
Despite him being beaten up without stop, he could tell that something was changing. Actually, his condition was already a lot better than before, and it had only been a few hours since they started.
It was not a one-sided beating. Yes, Aeliana was fast, but she was limiting her speed to the point where Nux could just barely react to her movements.
She had been testing Nux's limits for a long time now. This was also the reason Nux was able to block some of her attacks when the two started.
Yes, it didn't happen because of Nux's excellent battle instinct.

He was able to block because Aeliana wanted him to. She wanted to see at what speed Nux was able to block some of her attacks. Once she pushed him to the limit, she continued to attack at that speed until Nux was comfortable enough to block 5 out of 10 attacks before she increased her speed again.
It was a perfect form of training for someone like Nux, who had completely lost control over his body.
Nux's biggest problem right now was his body that had grown too fast. Because of this, everything had turned into a mess.

Before, his [Sense] was so quick that it was no different than seeing things with his eyes instead. Since [Sense] could see everything happening around him instead of only the things that happened in front of him, for Nux, it was like he had eyes all over his body. With Zenith Flow, he had trained his body to the point where every single part of his body moved on its own without him having to think about it.
By deleting this 'thinking' process, he became much faster than others and Nux didn't
stop at training his body to move on its own, he assimilated his other abilities with it as well.

In the end, once he completely mastered the Zenith Flow, he created a technique where he was no different than an automated bot that, even in his sleep, could fight against any opponent without making a single mistake.
Now, however, because his body had become so much stronger, every single one of his actions returned results far from his expectations.
When he jumped, he would jump too high. When he moved, he would move too fast or too far away. In other words, the 'memories' he had imprinted in his muscles became absolutely useless.
And since every single one of his abilities was assimilated into his body, his abilities were affected by this change as well.
Yes, everything went to shit.
Even moving in a straight line was a challenge for him and while his condition did improve in his battle against the five Primordials, he was nowhere close to having the control he once had.

Now, however, under Aeliana's training, where Nux was forced to use his instincts to try and dodge her attacks, the rate at which he was improving was almost horrifying. Instead of destroying everything Nux had done so far and rebuilding it from the start, she was forcefully making his body adapt to the new changes by constantly pushing him to his limits.

It was a frustrating method where Nux would constantly be beaten up and unlike when Vyriana did it without mercy, inflicting as much pain as she could so he would get used to it, Aeliana made sure not to hurt him.
They were more like 'light taps' to someone at his level, and that made it even more annoying.
After all, with every exchange, he was being shown how large the difference between the two of them was, and it was not a good feeling.
"Aagghhh!!!"
Nux screamed in anger as he fell to the ground again.
This time, he had gone against this woman for 36 hours straight, but even now, he hadn't landed a single punch.
Aeliana materialized in front of him without as much as a single drop of sweat on her face. For her, pushing Nux to this condition was like a walk in the park.
"You give up too quickly,"
Aeliana spoke with a frown.
"Vyriana said you were quite resilient, so why do you need rest after every few hours?"
"Please hit me harder."
Nux spoke with a serious look on his face. His mind was so occupied with his other thoughts that he didn't even realize what he had just said.
Aeliana blinked in surprise.
'She didn't tell me... this...'
Nux, however, still didn't understand what he had done.
And you couldn't blame the man either.
He was used to training with a heartless monster like Vyriana. That Dragon made him fight without his limbs!
She even plucked his eyes out and made him fight in that condition!
Why else do you think Nux was so calm while facing Zyros and others? He had been through much worse.

And now, this woman was just lightly tapping him while she threw him around. It was similar to an extremely fast mosquito continuously flying around you and biting you, and every time you tried to attack back, it disappeared.
You then take your stance, prepared to get rid of this annoying bug, but it is so fast that even after you give it your all, you only get to see it when it's already sitting on your
body. When you attack it, it disappears again.
For Nux, this thing continued for 36 straight hours.
Even when he trained with Vyriana, every time he fell, because his body was so damaged and for the sake of training his regeneration, the woman let him rest.
But this Vampire?
She just tapped him so lightly that every time he fell, he was forced to stand up again
and face her again...
Without a single break throughout the ordeal, not even for a single minute.
Nux was losing his mind!

chapters.title: Chapter 1784 Didn’t I tell you not to come unless Vyriana wakes up?
paragraphs: "Tired again?"
Aeliana questioned as she crouched next to Nux.
Nux glanced at her beautiful face and, for the first time in his long life, he was more scared of this beautiful woman in front of him than turned on.
Her stable breathing, a face without a drop of sweat, and the very slightly playful look on her face horrified him.
"I... I am never going to... succeed,"
He said in despair as he gasped for breath.
25 years...
He had been facing this woman for 25 years straight, and from start to finish, nothing, absolutely nothing, had changed.
He hadn't landed a single hit and was being beaten like a rag doll.
"Do you not get tired!?"
He questioned, his frustration clear.

This man...
He had been training with a Primordial for 25 years without any major breaks, and he was asking the Primordial if she was tired or not!?
Just what in the hell was wrong with this man's head!?
'How is he keeping up...?"
Aeliana couldn't help but wonder.
Let alone Divines, she had never seen even the Primordials lasting this long against her. This man's stamina had already surpassed all other Primordials she had seen.
Actually, Aeliana believed that his stamina was even higher than hers.

After all, unlike her, who was holding back most of her powers, this man was constantly being pushed to his limit for a straight 25 years, and despite that, only his breathing was ragged, and Aeliana knew that even that would return to normal in a matter of minutes and they could continue again.
A strength of a High-Level World, huh..."
She muttered in her mind.
'And to think this is severely restricted because he is not in his own Universe.
Aeliana was having a hard time believing this man's existence.
Just the fact that he had a literal Universe inside of him was enough to scare anyone, but what surprised Aeliana even further was how quickly this man improved.
At first, she thought that he was only improving because they had just begun his training. After a while, his improvement rate would start slowing down, just like how it happens with others.
It was only later that she realized how mistaken she was.
Vyriana was right. The rate at which he improves is out of this Universe."
Instead of slowing down, Nux continued to improve at an even faster rate, blocking more and more of her attacks.
His reactions were getting absurdly quick, blocking her attacks at the very last second
even.

She, however, didn't let any of this show on her face and stared at Nux.
"How long are you going to rest for? It has only been half a year."
"Half a year in Yrniel, that is,"
Nux complained.
"You count the time according to the place we are in. That's the basics of training!"
"Yeah? Who said the trainee gets to decide that?
I am the master. I will be the one making rules.
Now stand up. Your performance isn't great enough to deserve a longer rest,"
Aeliana spoke with a cold look on her face.
"Haaahh..."
Nux heaved a long sigh as he then stood up.
No matter how much he wanted to rest, right now, Aeliana's words were absolute.
The next instant, the lazy and loosened-up Aura around Nux changed.
His eyes pierced through Aeliana's body as he prepared himself.
Then, he rushed toward Aeliana.
His speed was so fast that it all looked like a blur.
A thing to note was that even when Nux moved with his absurd speed, he didn't leave any marks or crack the ground beneath him because he used too much force; the
ground was perfectly fine.
BOOOM
Nux, however, was not.
As he punched the woman, thinking he had finally got her, the Vampire disappeared and
punched him.
Once again, he was unable to react or block and was sent flying.
The assault then continued as Nux continued to get beaten up.
A few hours passed by just like that, but then, Nux's shadow trembled.
Nux frowned.
Aeliana, who was about to approach Nux and attack him, paused as she materialized
herself next to him.
She didn't need to ask. She already knew what was about to happen.
After all, this wasn't the first time this had happened.
And just as the Vampire expected, Nux's shadow extended further and suddenly, an
extremely beautiful woman materialized in front of them.
"Amaya,"
Nux greeted with a light smile on his face.
Without saying anything, the devourer launched herself at Nux, filling her body with
Vitamin Nux that she had been missing for a while now.
Nux just smiled, allowing her to do what she wanted, and hugged her back.
After all, he needed his Vitamin Amaya as well, especially after years of this cruel
training.
After the hug, a serious look appeared on Nux's face.
"Is she awake yet?"
Hearing that question, Amaya's smile disappeared.
"She is not."
She shook her head.
Nux muttered.
Half a year had passed, but Vyriana still hadn't woken up.
"Lady Sylvara says she is already healed. The reason she isn't waking up is because she
doesn't want to.
She... seems to be dealing with something,"
Amaya spoke with an unsure look on her face.
Nux was silent as well.
"It is natural. Do not overthink it,"
Aeliana suddenly commented.
"At the critical moment, she must have been enlightened and she just doesn't want to
waste this opportunity by breaking her focus.
Give her some time. She will wake up soon."
"I understand,"
Nux nodded.
He knew this was a normal occurrence, but he was still worried.
Aeliana, however, was merciless.
The Vampire then turned toward Amaya, and the two women stared at each other.
"Why are you here? Didn't I tell you not to come unless Vyriana wakes up?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1785 Husband Stealer!
paragraphs: "Why are you here? Didn't I tell you not to come unless Vyriana wakes up?"
Aeliana spoke as she glared at the Devourer, and the moment those words left her mouth, Nux could see the world around him freeze up.
'Fuck...'
He cursed inwardly, his eyes falling on Amaya, who was staring at Acliana with a 'smile' on her face.
Then, he glanced at Aeliana, who was looking at Amaya with an annoyed frown on her face. Clearly, the Vampire didn't want the Devourer here, and the Devourer could see
that.
"I didn't know I needed someone's permission to see MY husband," Amaya replied, the 'smile' on her face never fading.
"I assumed it was common sense to not interrupt one's training" Aeliana replied, the frown on her face deepening even further.
"And I assumed it was common sense to not stay with someone else's husband for a long time."

"If you for some reason have not understood it yet, then let me make it clear, I am helping my benefactor, my disciple's, and my friend's husband here. The only one not doing anything here and being a hindrance overall is you."
Aeliana's response was sharp.
"I would have considered it a help if I did not know the whole story.
"You will not leave me, not until you can defeat me."
Did you think I did not see that?
Let me tell you, new girl,
I live in his shadow, I see everything he sees, I keep an eye on every single thing, so don't think I do not know what you are trying to do."
Amaya replied.
"Oh yeah? And what is it?"
"You want to spend more time with my husband! Training him is just an excuse.
And not leaving until he can defeat you? Woman, you train with Transcendent Level Beings, that is two whole phases above him, and you expect him to defeat you? Does that even make sense!?
How shameless can you be!?
Why don't you outright say that you are eyeing my husband!?
You husband stealer!
You don't even have enough guts to admit your own feelings and use these pathetic excuses to keep my husband with you! How dare you stand in front of me!?"
Amaya pointed her fingers at Aeliana, without holding anything back.
Aeliana's mouth twitched when she heard those words. She clenched her fists and lowered her head, trying to hold her emotions from bursting out.
Nux, who saw this, realized that it had long passed the levels of normal banter and decided to intervene,
"Tha-"
However, before he could say anything,
"So what?"
Suddenly, Aeliana raised her head, her crimson eyes shining so... menacingly that, for a moment, Nux was taken aback.
"Huh?" Amaya frowned.
BOOOM
But suddenly, a suffocating aura burst out from Acliana as she walked forward.
"What can you do?"
The Vampire questioned.
Amaya narrowed her eyes, staring at her, her eyes as menacing as hers, if not more.
"Did you just call me a husband stealer...?"
Aeliana questioned in a chilling tone.
"Are you not on-"
Amaya wanted to reply, but Aeliana interrupted,
"What are you going to do,
Even if I am one."
Aeliana spoke as suddenly, she grabbed Nux's arm and pulled him close to her.
Then, looking at the shocked Amaya one last time, she spoke,
"What are you going to do even if I do intend to steal your husband?"
"Wh-"
Before Nux could speak, his lips were scaled.
He felt a cold, almost too soft pair of lips on his. In an instant, his body felt like it would melt, but suddenly, he felt a strong pull that pushed his body towards Acliana, not even
allowing air to pass through them.
His eyes widened as he realized what just happened, his body froze.
Aeliana, however, didn't stop and continued to press her lips on Nux's.
Now, she didn't know how to continue, and her movements were awkward, but that just heightened the charm of this moment even further.

Slowly, Nux started moving, his hands trailed towards Aeliana's back, feeling every part of her body on their way. He started sucking Aeliana's lower lip. Aeliana, who tried to copy his movements, started sucking his upper lip.
Aeliana's messy emotions were all over the place, and soon, her instincts overpowered
her, and
Bite
Her fangs elongated, and she then bit. Nux's lip, sucking blood out of them.

Nux's body trembled. The feeling of his blood being sucked out of his lips wasn't new, but having Aeliana do it was a fantasy he had been thinking of for the longest time, and now that it had finally come true...
He felt like he was losing his mind.

It wasn't just him. Aeliana, who tasted Nux's blood for the first time, not to mention in this manner, felt her entire body trembling. A strange wave of pleasure weakened her, her legs felt like they would give up at any moment now.
However, this was just the beginning.
After all, she wasn't the only Vampire here.
Bite
Nux bit her lip as well.
"Mnnhh~"
A moan escaped Aeliana's mouth as she felt her blood being sucked out. In an instant, her legs gave out. If it wasn't for Nux holding her in his arms, she would have collapsed
that instant.
However, in this condition, the Vampire didn't stop sucking Nux's blood.
It was a feeling she had never experienced before.
As a Vampire, she had constantly drunk the blood of the most exotic of beasts. She had even drunk Progenitors' blood, and when Azriel woke up, she consumed her father's
blood as well. But this...
Nux's blood was different.
Not only was it much tastier, but unlike all the blood she had consumed before, she was
devouring this particular one from its very source.
The feeling was so... euphoric... that she couldn't stop, even when her body had next to no strength, and the only reason she was holding on was because of the man who was
carrying her.
For the first time in her life, Aeliana was drunk in pleasure.
And the lucky man who was enjoying this all could not be happier. His hands were
allowed to explore every part of this Vampire's alluring body, his brain was constantly being attacked by pleasure waves as he sensed the Vampire all over his body.
Right now, Nux was the happiest man alive.
And then, he heard a playful voice in his head.
'I am expecting a reward soon, okay?"
Nux extended his senses to look back, and his eyes fell on Amaya, who was smiling at him
before she returned to his shadows.
'Don't forget it, my dear husband.'
'She...
Did this on purpose...?
Amaya...?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1786 Why did you do it?
paragraphs: Amaya materialized inside Nux's universe as shadow pulled her in.
"I didn't think you would do that.
The first wife walked towards her and spoke in a surprised tone.
"It worked because it was me."
Amaya answered with a shrug.
"I get that..."
Felberta nodded.
Everyone knew what sort of woman Amaya was. Her helping another woman get close to Nux? None of these women, who had stayed and known Amaya for thousands of years, could imagine something like that.
This was also the reason why her words were so effective. After all, not even in her wildest dreams would Aeliana guess that Amaya, of all people, would try and give her the last push she needed.
She was completely caught off guard, and the same was true for Felberta.
"I just do not understand why you would do something like that..."
Felberta commented with a frown.
Lane and Shadow Lane, the only women left inside Nux's Universe together with Amaya and Felberta, were confused as well.
Amaya ignored the three women staring at her and glanced at the 'screen' in front of her, the screen that showed Nux's vision.
"It was getting frustrating."
After a while, Amaya answered.
"What do you mean?" Felberta tilted her head in confusion.
"Watching that woman blush was annoying"
"You did this just because you were getting annoyed...?"
Felberta frowned.
This was completely out of character for Amaya.
What in the hell is she thinking?
She wondered.
Seeing her reaction, Amaya shook her head,
"You do not get it."
"Get what?"
Amaya then pointed at Aeliana, who was on the screen, and,
"That one is an old woman, an old Vampire who doesn't completely understand the emotions she is feeling.

It wouldn't be a problem if she was just some other woman. The problem is, she was born with a good head. She is someone who never had trouble understanding people. She is the leader of the strongest force here, after all.
The fact that she, someone who prided herself on being able to handle most matters, is unable to understand her own thoughts would constantly trouble her.
So she would look more into it. She would try to understand what she does not. understand by trying to experience it more.
The signs were shown before.
She started with keeping a constant eye on Nux. However, there was only so much she could understand when she is so far away from him.
In the end, she would get frustrated, and once that happened..."
Amaya then turned towards Felberta and,
"What do you think she would do?"
"What?"
"She would try to keep him next to her."
Felberta's expression changed when she heard those words.
However, Amaya wasn't done yet.
"But Nux likes to be unrestricted, and she knows it.
In the end, that woman would never do something that would upset Nux, so she had to keep her desires in,"
"Until Nux gave her a perfect reason..."
Felberta muttered, her eyes shining with enlightenment.
"Indeed."
Amaya nodded.

"That bitch is Vyriana's closest friend. She should know how much Nux desired to get stronger and could do anything for it, and in a state where his body was out of sync and he needed someone's help to regain his control,
It was a perfect opportunity."
"She decided to train Nux so that she could stay with him." Lane muttered.
"Yes,"
Amaya nodded.
"It wouldn't have been a problem if her goal was just to train him. That would actually be
a good thing. After all, when all is said and done, she is an exceptional cultivator. But the problem is that her goal was never to train Nux"
"It was to stay with him for as long as she could, until she understood her feelings and conquered them."
Felberta spoke, and once again, Amaya nodded.
"This is why she came up with that absurd condition of Nux defeating her before he is
allowed to leave again.
Again, if it was any other Primordial Level Being, it wouldn't have been a problem.
But that woman is absurdly strong."
Amaya spoke with a frown on her face. She didn't like praising that crazy vampire, but
she had to admit the truth.
"From the very beginning, she knew Nux would never be able to defeat her, at least not anytime soon."
Amaya spoke, but Felberta frowned.
"But she didn't know how strong Nux had actually become when he first came here, and
he did defeat five strong Primordials on his own...
How was she so sure this would work out?"
"Confidence."
Amaya shrugged, turning back towards the screen.
"This woman is said to be strong enough to take on the entire Ancestral Order on her
own. She didn't know how strong Nux was at the start,
But she was absolutely confident that she wouldn't lose."
"To have that sort of confidence..."
"What can you do?
She is just that strong"
Amaya answered.
Felberta stared at the devourer. She wanted to say something, but she knew Amaya
wouldn't like it, so she kept silent.
Shadow, however, didn't have that filter.
"You sound like her fan.
Are you thinking of making her your role model or something? Or are you going to be
her new disciple?
That would be exciting to see."
Shadow laughed.
Amaya's mouth twitched when she heard those words, but before she could say
anything, Shadow continued,
"But I must say, you cannot help but be influenced by this woman.
I think that is the most helpless I have ever seen Nux be,"
The Shadow turned towards Lane and tilted her head,
"No?"
After all, the two of them had stayed next to Nux almost the entire time. Every time he
trained with Astaria, Thyra, Rune, or even Vyriana, Lane and her Shadow were there
most of the time.
At her words, Lane nodded.
She had never seen Nux cry hopelessly. She never expected to hear words like, 'I am
never going to succeed, come out of Nux's mouth.
But...
"The rate at which he improved has never been faster.
Lane replied, staring at the screen.
After all, right now, Nux wasn't hesitating and was holding Aeliana with all his strength,
but despite that, his touch was extremely gentle.
It was as if... he had perfect control over his body.

Her helping another woman get close to Nux?
None of these women, who had stayed and known Amaya for thousands of years, could imagine something like that.
This was also the reason why her words were so effective.
After all, not even in her wildest dreams would Aeliana guess that Amaya, of all people, would try and give her the last push she needed.
She was completely caught off guard, and the same was true for Felberta.
"I just do not understand why you would do something like that..."
Felberta commented with a frown.
Lane and Shadow Lane, the only women left inside Nux's Universe together with Amaya and Felberta, were confused as well.
Amaya ignored the three women staring at her and glanced at the 'screen' in front of her, the screen that showed Nux's vision.
"It was getting frustrating."
After a while, Amaya answered.
"What do you mean?" Felberta tilted her head in confusion.
"Watching that woman blush was annoying"
"You did this just because you were getting annoyed...?"
Felberta frowned.
This was completely out of character for Amaya.
What in the hell is she thinking?
She wondered.
Seeing her reaction, Amaya shook her head,
"You do not get it."
"Get what?"
Amaya then pointed at Aeliana, who was on the screen, and,
"That one is an old woman, an old Vampire who doesn't completely understand the emotions she is feeling.
It wouldn't be a problem if she was just some other woman.
The problem is, she was born with a good head.
She is someone who never had trouble understanding people.
She is the leader of the strongest force here, after all.
The fact that she, someone who prided herself on being able to handle most matters, is unable to understand her own thoughts would constantly trouble her.
So she would look more into it.
She would try to understand what she does not. understand by trying to experience it more.
The signs were shown before.
She started with keeping a constant eye on Nux.
However, there was only so much she could understand when she is so far away from him.
In the end, she would get frustrated, and once that happened..."
Amaya then turned towards Felberta and,
"What do you think she would do?"
"What?"
"She would try to keep him next to her."
Felberta's expression changed when she heard those words.
However, Amaya wasn't done yet.
"But Nux likes to be unrestricted, and she knows it.
In the end, that woman would never do something that would upset Nux, so she had to keep her desires in,"
"Until Nux gave her a perfect reason..."
Felberta muttered, her eyes shining with enlightenment.
"Indeed."
Amaya nodded.
"That bitch is Vyriana's closest friend.
She should know how much Nux desired to get stronger and could do anything for it, and in a state where his body was out of sync and he needed someone's help to regain his control,
It was a perfect opportunity."
"She decided to train Nux so that she could stay with him." Lane muttered.
"Yes,"
Amaya nodded.
"It wouldn't have been a problem if her goal was just to train him.
That would actually be
a good thing.
After all, when all is said and done, she is an exceptional cultivator.
But the problem is that her goal was never to train Nux"
"It was to stay with him for as long as she could, until she understood her feelings and conquered them."
Felberta spoke, and once again, Amaya nodded.
"This is why she came up with that absurd condition of Nux defeating her before he is
allowed to leave again.
Again, if it was any other Primordial Level Being, it wouldn't have been a problem.
But that woman is absurdly strong."
Amaya spoke with a frown on her face.
She didn't like praising that crazy vampire, but
she had to admit the truth.
"From the very beginning, she knew Nux would never be able to defeat her, at least not anytime soon."
Amaya spoke, but Felberta frowned.
"But she didn't know how strong Nux had actually become when he first came here, and
he did defeat five strong Primordials on his own...
How was she so sure this would work out?"
"Confidence."
Amaya shrugged, turning back towards the screen.
"This woman is said to be strong enough to take on the entire Ancestral Order on her
own.
She didn't know how strong Nux was at the start,
But she was absolutely confident that she wouldn't lose."
"To have that sort of confidence..."
"What can you do?
She is just that strong"
Amaya answered.
Felberta stared at the devourer.
She wanted to say something, but she knew Amaya
wouldn't like it, so she kept silent.
Shadow, however, didn't have that filter.
"You sound like her fan.
Are you thinking of making her your role model or something?
Or are you going to be
her new disciple?
That would be exciting to see."
Shadow laughed.
Amaya's mouth twitched when she heard those words, but before she could say
anything, Shadow continued,
"But I must say, you cannot help but be influenced by this woman.
I think that is the most helpless I have ever seen Nux be,"
The Shadow turned towards Lane and tilted her head,
"No?"
After all, the two of them had stayed next to Nux almost the entire time.
Every time he
trained with Astaria, Thyra, Rune, or even Vyriana, Lane and her Shadow were there
most of the time.
At her words, Lane nodded.
She had never seen Nux cry hopelessly.
She never expected to hear words like, 'I am
never going to succeed, come out of Nux's mouth.
But...
"The rate at which he improved has never been faster.
Lane replied, staring at the screen.
After all, right now, Nux wasn't hesitating and was holding Aeliana with all his strength,
but despite that, his touch was extremely gentle.
It was as if... he had perfect control over his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1787 Fuck, why does she look so adorable?
paragraphs: "So the reason you did that..."
"If I didn't do it, she would never let. Nux leave before he wins," Amaya spoke with an annoyed look on her face.
"And whether I want to admit it or not...
That is not going to happen anytime soon.
Nux knows it as well."
"Hasn't he already regained most of his control?" Shadow questioned with a frown.
"That's the problem."
Felberta jumped in, and Amaya nodded.
"Even though he has regained most of his control, he still hasn't landed a single hit on that woman.
Aeliana is still holding back, and we do not even know to what extent.
The very fact that she is not even tired, even after all this, is enough for us to guess that she still has a lot to show."
"So what you are saying is that even if Nux regains complete control over his body and masters Zenith Flow again, he still cannot win?" Shadow questioned.
"Probably," Amaya nodded with a grim look on her face.
"What sort of monster is that woman?"
"An annoying one, that's for sure." Amaya snorted.
'Old hag:
She cursed in her head.
"So she never planned to let Nux leave...
How needy" Shadow muttered without a filter. Then, her eyes fell on Amaya.
"I can't believe you put so much thought into it.
As I expected, the crazy ones have an entirely different wiring in their heads, eh?"
Her tone was full of respect.
Amaya's mouth twitched.
"But..." Suddenly, Felberta frowned.

"What makes you think that woman would let Nux go after this? I get that after that push, she might understand her feelings better, but won't this cause her to be even more possessive? What if this just strengthens her desire to keep Nux next to her?"
It was a perfectly logical question.
Amaya, however, just smiled menacingly.
"Did you forget who we are talking about here?"
"That woman might be strong, much more than what any of us expected,
But there is no way an old virgin like her would last, especially against. Nux.
Just look at her."
Amaya spoke as she pointed at the screen. Seeing Aeliana's legs giving out as Nux sucked her blood, her menacing grin widened.
'She...
S-So this is what she was planning...'
Felberta was taken aback.
She couldn't help but agree with what Shadow said before.
The crazy ones indeed had their heads wired in an entirely different manner.
"Anh-"
Suddenly, the women heard Aeliana moan.
They all glanced at the screen and saw how Nux leaned even further, his hands feeling every part of Acliana's body.
In the end, Aeliana couldn't take any more of this foreign, strange feeling in her heart and pushed Nux away.
She stumbled, her pale face was red like a tomato.
"Fuck, why does she look so adorable?
Even I want to fuck h-mmmnffff!!"
Before Shadow could complete, Lane grabbed her mouth.
Amaya and Felberta completely ignored Shadow, their eyes were fixed on Lane, who
simply turned her head away, refusing to say anything.
On the other hand, Aeliana, who was too embarrassed, could feel her heart beating like it would burst out anymore,
"Ael-"Nux tried to approach her, but then,
"Take a break.
I-I will be back soon."
The woman spoke as she disappeared, not allowing Nux to say anything.
The moment that happened, Amaya's grin widened even further.
'All according to my plan, she thought inwardly.
Felberta, on the other hand, was horrified.
She swore in her heart to not get in Amaya's bad book.
Amaya, however, didn't even think of anything else. She just wanted to leave and go to Nux in order to claim her reward, but suddenly, she froze as the space in front of Nux
was torn open.
A black-haired, crimson-eyed man stepped out of the torn space, the expression on his face was anything but good.
The man called out, his expression sent shivers down the women's spines.
"You dare take advantage of my innocent little girl when she generously tried to help you
regain your control, you brat?"
Azriel spoke, glaring at Nux.
He really wanted to get rid of this hateful man.
Nux was silent.
Shadow, however, was not.
"Is this old man blind!?
Does he not know that it was his girl who took advantage of our innocent husband!?"
She screamed out loud.
Suddenly, the women saw Azriel looking straight. It was as if he was staring at them
through the screen.
Just as the women were about to deny that possibility, they heard a voice,
"Come out, I know you are watching."
Azriel ordered.
The women gulped, looking at each other.
This time, even Amaya was slightly intimidated.
"We need to go," Felberta spoke with a serious look on her face.
After all, they couldn't ignore someone like Azriel.
The other women nodded, so all of them, except Lane, appeared behind Nux.
"Where is the last one?" Azriel questioned. Soon, however, he shook his head.
"Right, let her stay in."
He nodded with an understanding look on his face.
'He knows...' Amaya noted as she stared at the strongest being in the entire Universe.
'I wonder how much he actually knows."
As Amaya observed Azriel, she noticed him turning towards her.
"You are a daring one," Azriel muttered.
Amaya was silent.
There were a lot of things she could say, but in front of this man, she decided it would be
better to stay silent.
"The daring one's your daughter."
A voice was heard, and in an instant, Amaya and Felberta turned towards Shadow, their
mouths twitching.
'How did Lane keep this one in control...?"
They couldn't help but question in their head.
They turned to see Azriel's reaction and were surprised when they saw his reaction
wasn't as strong as they were expecting.
Rather, he was looking at Nux and,
"So you devoured a High-Level World?"
He questioned.
"I did," Nux nodded.
"What did you learn?" Azriel questioned.
"A lot of things..."
Nux answered, his tone seemed little different, making the women frown.

Nux, on the other hand, continued to observe Azriel. He still hadn't forgotten that entity that destroyed Umbrasol, the horrifying aura, the dominance, the overwhelming presence... he remembered every single thing, and...
This man here was stronger than that horrifying entity.
When that realization sank in, Nux's respect for Azriel rose up.
Azriel stared at Nux, a slight frown appearing on his face when he noticed his expression. Soon, however, he shook his head, not thinking too much about it and said
what he actually came here to say, "Take care of my daughter."

chapters.title: Chapter 1788 I understand, father-in-law.
paragraphs: "Take care of my daughter."
Nux and the others blinked in surprise. They were in utter disbelief.
They even thought that they had heard it wrong.
Did... this man just give his permission?
Did he accept Nux as his son-in-law?
A frown appeared on Nux's face. He didn't think it would be that easy.
"What happened?"
He questioned directly.
For some reason, he didn't like this.
"Tell me if this does not have 'flag' written all over it!
Nux thought inwardly.

Despite having millions of years of knowledge in his head, he still hadn't forgotten the divine knowledge, the knowledge he inherited from Earth, the knowledge from all the manga, anime, and other cultural stuff.
When has a character who said something like this not died?
It clearly looked like Azriel was prepared to do something and was leaving Aeliana in his care since he knew he wouldn't return.
Every cultured man could see that.
Nux, however, couldn't allow this to happen. After all, Aeliana was deeply connected with her father. If something happened to this man, she would break apart, and Nux could not let that happen.
"What are you talking about?"
Azriel frowned.

"I am asking, what are you trying to hide? What are you trying to do? I am telling you this beforehand, don't try something foolish. Acliana wouldn't like it. She has just started smiling again because she can finally spend time with her father, don't take that happiness away from her."
Nux spoke with a solemn look on his face, his eyes scanning for even the slightest. change in Azriel's expression, and what he did see was...
His mouth twitching without stopping.
"What are you trying to say, you brat? I am taking away her happiness by not spending more time with her? Me?
Aren't you the one who is coming between you and me!?
Isn't it already good that I am not wiping you out of existence for getting close to my daughter and am generously allowing you to take her hand!?
Or are you actually tired of living?"
The man threatened, his crimson eyes staring at Nux, sending shivers down his spine.
"The hell is wrong with this fucker?
Why doesn't he follow the script?'
It didn't take long for Nux to realize that he had misunderstood, this, however, made him frown.

"I thought you would try and come between me and Aeliana. Then I would need to somehow run away with her and return to you once we have a child, and then you will finally accept us when you see your grandchild..."
Nux continued to mutter.
Amaya, however, could see how, with every word he spoke, he made the situation worse.
Why did she have to fall for this bastard out of billions of beings in the entire Universe...?"
Azriel thought in his head.
Soon, however, a serious look appeared on his face and,
"Alright, that's enough."
He ordered.
Nux paused.
"I won't stop you from courting my daughter."
The Vampire spoke. Then, after a slight pause, he continued,
"I only have one request."

"Request' was a strong word, especially when it came from someone like Azriel. Right now, however, Nux could see it. The man in front of him was not the strongest being in the entire Universe, he was just a father who loved his daughter more than himself.
"Please take care of my daughter."
Azriel spoke. The Vampire even went ahead to bow his head, but before he could, Nux appeared in front of him.
"Lord Azriel."
He called out, this time, there was no hint of playfulness on his face.
"Please do not bow your head,
It will break Acliana's heart.
She is the daughter of the strongest being in the entire Universe, and she is very proud
of her father. Don't ruin it for her."
Nux then looked into Azriel's eyes and,
"The strongest does not bow. Especially not to his stupid son-in-law.
If there is something you want, do not request it of me, order me with authority."
The absolute seriousness as he said those words surprised not just Azriel but even Nux's
wives as well.
They understood, this was Nux's respect, not just for his father-in-law, but for the
strongest being in the universe.
"Order you, huh..."
Azriel muttered, slightly amused.
"Would you leave my daughter alone if I order you to?"
The Vampire tried his luck, using this one last chance to save his daughter from falling into the deepest pit that existed in this Universe, or in this case, outside of this Universe.
"I won't. Your authority doesn't extend that far." Nux's answer was instantaneous.
"You are an insolent one."
Azriel chuckled.
A sight that surprised all that were present.
"This is the first time this man has laughed in a non-threatening manner, isn't it?"
The moment they heard those words, once again, Amaya and Felberta's mouths
twitched.

They really needed to keep Shadow in check. Yes, the two women were now understanding Lane's troubles. They felt like Shadow was speaking whatever was in their minds, and it wasn't a good feeling at all. Especially when they felt like they might die for
it at any moment.
Azriel, however, ignored Shadow's words. He glanced at Nux, and Nux nodded,
"I assure you, Lord Azriel. I will never let your daughter down. In life or death, I will never leave her alone."
Azriel smiled. For some reason, those words relieved his heart. Suddenly, he turned
towards Amaya and the others and,
"Please take care of her.
"She will be like our sister, a part of our family. Of course, we will take care of her"
Felberta nodded with a smile. On the other hand, Amaya had already moved towards Shadow, forcefully closing her mouth. The devourer even used her ability to cut Shadow
off from the surroundings, making sure she had no way to give her input in the situation.
Azriel just ignored that. He was familiar with this family's antics. He just turned around, but before he disappeared, he glanced at Nux and,
"I know you have a few things you need to take care of right now. Do that, and once you are about to leave Yrniel for good, come to me. There are some things we need to talk
about."'
"I understand, father-in-law."
Nux bowed his head, and Azriel disappeared.

them from the rampant Death Energy inside.
All you need to do is go and devour them."
"You found eleven of them already?"
"Astaria and others had been acting as mercenaries for a long time now, so they knew
quite a lot. I just needed to put together what they knew and come up with a plan.
Of course, the limitations were quite severe, so we couldn't do a lot. I prioritized short.
time over other things. I thought you would want the same."
Amaya spoke, and it didn't have to be said she was right.
After all, the women knew Nux the best, and right now, what Nux wanted the most
was to help Eisheth and Lyriana form a Law.

By severing the connections of selected individuals, they would divert the Universe's
attention away from Yrniel and its people.

The targets must be criminals who deserved nothing but death.

capture the targets.

Universe.

after their Bloodlines.

paragraphs: "These are the ones...?"
Nux, who entered Reaper's Veil together with Felberta and Amaya, questioned as he glanced at the sight in front of him.
Eleven 'targets' they had captured, all with their limbs severed, unconscious and surrounded by Devouring Mist that protected them from this environment.
"Yes"
Amaya and Felberta nodded.
Evane was still with Vyriana in case she needed something, Shadow was inside his Universe, and Riona stayed behind in case they needed something.
The rest of the women couldn't move since they could be detected by the Universe. Right now, these women were looking into Missions provided to Elite Mercenaries and were planning to join the War.
Yes, everyone was busy. Even Nux had to return to Aeliana to continue their training, so Amaya didn't waste time either.
She manipulated the Devouring Mist, uncovering the first 'victim' and revealing a humanoid entity with translucent skin showing faint 'veins' of different colors all over its body.
Amaya started explaining,
"That's the first one.
A Chronovian.
This one's Law is too weak to mention. It is just something that strengthens his defense to some extent, but since you have Mother's Law, it won't matter. However, his bloodline is quite special.

They can manifest 'echoes' of themselves from alternate timelines, and each echo can act independently for a limited time. Essentially, it's a cloning ability, but unlike your clones that can only copy your abilities, with this ability, it might be possible to copy your physical power as well."
Nux widened his eyes in surprise. However, before he could get his hopes up, Amaya
burst his bubble.

"Don't get too excited. I am not sure if this ability is that strong. The concept of different timelines is quite complicated. Not to mention the energy it requires to keep those clones is massive, and in your case...
Where you will pretty much be summoning an entirely different Universe from a different timeline, it is very likely that this will be out of this ability's scope."
Nux understood that.
After all, this ability was not an Absolute; it could fail. Not that it mattered. Even if it did fail, Nux believed that he would get something out of this.
He stepped forward and placed his hands on the man's head. The next instant, he let his Black Hole take over, and the Chronovian was surrounded with Black Mist.
The man's connection with the main Universe was severed. The Black Hole instantly devoured his Bloodline.

He was a Sovereign Level entity that came from a Low-Level World. In his World, he was one of the powerhouses, and his Bloodline was pure. Nux could see it was on the same level as a Primordial Level Bloodline.
As for it being from a Low-Level World, that didn't matter since its connection to its world was severed.
Yes, Nux had now assimilated another Primordial Level Bloodline from a High-Level World into his Bloodline.
The next moment, a new influx of knowledge poured into Nux's mind, telling him everything he needed to know about the man's Law (which Nux completely disregarded) and his Bloodline.
"Hmm."
Nux muttered. Usually, such a big influx of knowledge regarding a completely unknown bloodline would have been a bit painful, but for Nux, the process couldn't be
any smoother.
"How is it?"
Felberta questioned.
Nux glanced at her and shook his head,
"Amaya was right, I cannot summon my Clones."
Felberta and Amaya sighed. To not disappoint them, Nux smiled and said,
"But this Bloodline has a weak connection to a Law related to Time, which should be one of the Primordial Laws as well.
It is something that will be helpful in the future, so he was not entirely useless."
"We understand."
Amaya nodded as she waved her hand again, revealing the second victim. A being with a colorful body that seemed to refract light.
"A Luminis.
His ability isn't very special. One allows him to create somewhat durable objects, while the other allows him to bend light around him and become invisible.
His Law, however, is related to Light.
The Law of Illumination."
Amaya spoke, and Nux's eyes shined as he glanced at the being in front of him. Soon, however, he shook his head.
"The Black Hole isn't reacting on its own.
His Law is too weak to be considered a Law related to a Primordial Energy. It is similar
to how Thyra's Law couldn't be devoured because the aspect of 'Death' was too weak."
"So he's useless, huh..."
Felberta nodded, wanting to move on.
Nux, however, just shrugged,
"All of you have put in a lot of effort in finding these people after so many restrictions.
It doesn't matter even if they are useless. This is the best option we would find in Low-Level Worlds anyway."
Nux nodded as suddenly, black mist surrounded the being in front of him, and he was devoured.
Once again, Nux received the information related to his Law but didn't think about it too much. It was too weak for him to take notice.
The only thing he could do was strengthen it on his own later, but that would take time. For now, Nux decided to ignore it and moved forward.
"An Echoid.
This one would be a bit more useful.
Their blood allows them to capture, amplify, or weaponize sound waves, creating sonic barriers or destructive pulses. The more energy you put in, the stronger the
effect."
Nux raised his eyebrows in surprise,
"How did these people survive? Some High-Level World should have taken interest in
their blood."
"This one comes from a Middle-Level World."
Felberta chuckled.
"Huh?"
Nux was taken aback.
"A Mercenary?"
He guessed.
"Yeah, we got a bit lucky with this one."
Felberta answered.
Nux's smile widened as he then stepped forward and devoured this one as well.
"Actually, the next one: one of the better ones as well. Another mercenary."
"The mercenaries are everywhere, huh?" Nux muttered.
"Well, it's easy to know about more mercenaries when you are one as well,"
Felberta shrugged.
Amaya, on the other hand, continued as she revealed another creature,
"They are called Skyrends.
They can control the gravitational pull on themselves or objects, allowing them to walk on walls, hurl heavy objects as if weightless, or pin enemies to the ground.
They can even create something called Anti-Force Fields, a Zone of altered gravity to deflect projectiles or hinder movement.
Well, with their limited energy, that is the most they can do. But it's gravity. Combine
that with your endless reserve of energy,
I am sure something good will come out of it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1798 New Abilities, Bloodlines, and Laws.
paragraphs: "They are called Skyrends.
They can control the gravitational pull on themselves or objects, allowing them to walk on walls, hurl heavy objects as if weightless, or pin enemies to the ground.
They can even create something called an Anti-Force Field, a zone of altered gravity to deflect projectiles or hinder movement.
Well, with their limited energy, that is the most they can do, but it's gravity. Combine that with your endless reserve of energy,
I am sure something good will come out of it."
Amaya spoke confidently, and Nux nodded with a bright smile on his face.
"Of course,"
Without waiting any further, he devoured the Skyrend and absorbed everything the being had to offer.
"The next one is quite interesting as well," Amaya muttered.
Another plant-like creature was revealed.
"A Verdalian.
They have the power to embed seeds in allies or enemies. The allies are strengthened and healed continuously, while enemies are restricted or drained of energy.
A perfect support that can use both buffs and curses, and again, the strength of these buffs and curses depends on the amount of energy used."
The instant Nux heard those words, his smile widened.
He now understood.
These women weren't looking for bloodlines with stronger abilities, they were looking for bloodlines that would suit him the best because of his massive energy reserves.
"That works!
Nux smiled.
He knew he could leave things to his wives.
And as if proving his point even further, Amaya continued,
"The next one can create short-lived rifts to move instantaneously between two points."
The instant Nux heard those words, he glanced at Amaya, and the devourer smiled.
"Yes, his abilities are related to Space.
They come from his Law"
"Another Law that belongs to one of the Primordial Energies."
Nux's smile widened. Soon, however, he was slightly disappointed.
It was the same problem.
The Law was too weak.
Nux, however, didn't complain and devoured the Law,
Amaya continued, revealing another creature,
"He is a Prismorn.
He can manipulate emotions, amplifying fear, courage, or joy. He can even use emotional energy to power spells or physical strength."
"Ability to manipulate one's emotions?"

"I know you can do that using your illusions, but this is a much more direct method." Felberta answered, and Nux nodded in understanding. Soon, a playful smile appeared on his face as he stared at his wives.
"This seems useful indeed."
The women smiled, knowing exactly what Nux was thinking about.
"Anyways, the next is this Umbroknight.
Their power is somewhat special. They can connect with objects in Outer Space" "What?"
Nux blinked in surprise.
"Mhm, they have an ability named Astral Bond that allows them to call upon specific stars with unique powers.
They can summon meteors, heal with starlight, or even enhance their speed and strength using their connection with a specific star"
"That..."
"I thought it might be useful, especially for you."
Amaya spoke, her eyes staring at Nux, and he understood what she was trying to say.
An ability to connect with objects in Outer Space...
As a Universe himself, who knew what this ability could become in Nux's hands.
Of course, there were chances that it could be one of the many abilities Nux had and didn't use much, but in the end, it was still worth a try.
Without waiting any more time, Nux devoured the Umbroknight.
For now, Nux decided not to waste time understanding everything he had gained and continued further. There were still three more beings he needed to devour before Lyriana came here.
That was the priority. As for whether his strength increased or not, Nux would figure that out when he trained with Aeliana later.
"This one's quite interesting as well."
Felberta commented, her eyes glimmering as she waited for Amaya to reveal the ninth
one.
Amaya nodded back, and with a wave of her hand, the devouring mist disappeared, revealing another being with a semi-transparent body with swirling texts or symbols constantly shifting within him.
Nux raised his eyebrow when he saw how the being looked, and Felberta continued,
"Aetherialis.
By touching an object, person, or book, they can absorb its knowledge and temporarily gain skills or abilities tied to it. The amount of knowledge they absorb depends on how strong their minds are."
Nux stared at the Aetherialis, surprised.
"It is almost as if these beings are created to be devoured by me."
He couldn't help but comment.
"Indeed."
Felberta chuckled.
"They are much more intelligent than people around them since their strength depends on their intelligence, but despite that, they are severely limited.
After all, there is only so much knowledge one can absorb at one point. If they try to
go beyond that, their minds are overloaded. It often leads to some part of their memories being washed away, or sometimes, depending on the severity of the
situation, a complete mental wipeout.
This is also the reason why, despite sounding quite useful, not many higher-level worlds were attracted to this race."
Felberta then sighed dramatically and eyed Nux.
"If only there was a being who could absorb as much knowledge as he wanted without
any issues, how amazing would it be if such a being had their power, no?"
Nux chuckled when he heard her words. Without waiting, he devoured the Aetherialis
as well. This one came from a low-level world, so again, his bloodline was pure.
Yes, with this, Nux got another strong bloodline that now belonged to a high-level
"Now this is the tenth one."
Amaya continued, revealing a crystalline being with sharp edges.
"This one's a Shardkin.
When critically damaged, he shatters into smaller shards, which can combine
together, and when they do, his physical strength rises by a factor of two.
If you get this ability..."
Nux didn't need to think anymore and devoured the Shardkin.
"So, one more left, right?"
He questioned, and the women nodded.
"This is the one I caught at the end.
A Harmonic.
He can release spores that influence plant growth. These 'plants' create hallucinogenic
clouds that confuse the enemies. These plants can also bind and even 'eat' the weaker enemies, and again, the more energy used, the stronger these plants. So..."
Nux nodded in understanding as he devoured the last 'victim.' And now, it was time to rebuild the Elven Queen's foundation from scratch.
