"Another Law that belongs to one of the Primordial Energies."
Nux's smile widened.
Soon, however, he was slightly disappointed.
It was the same problem.
The Law was too weak.
Nux, however, didn't complain and devoured the Law,
Amaya continued, revealing another creature,
"He is a Prismorn.
He can manipulate emotions, amplifying fear, courage, or joy.
He can even use emotional energy to power spells or physical strength."
"Ability to manipulate one's emotions?"
"I know you can do that using your illusions, but this is a much more direct method." Felberta answered, and Nux nodded in understanding.
Soon, a playful smile appeared on his face as he stared at his wives.
"This seems useful indeed."
The women smiled, knowing exactly what Nux was thinking about.
"Anyways, the next is this Umbroknight.
Their power is somewhat special.
They can connect with objects in Outer Space" "What?"
Nux blinked in surprise.
"Mhm, they have an ability named Astral Bond that allows them to call upon specific stars with unique powers.
They can summon meteors, heal with starlight, or even enhance their speed and strength using their connection with a specific star"
"That..."
"I thought it might be useful, especially for you."
Amaya spoke, her eyes staring at Nux, and he understood what she was trying to say.
An ability to connect with objects in Outer Space...
As a Universe himself, who knew what this ability could become in Nux's hands.
Of course, there were chances that it could be one of the many abilities Nux had and didn't use much, but in the end, it was still worth a try.
Without waiting any more time, Nux devoured the Umbroknight.
For now, Nux decided not to waste time understanding everything he had gained and continued further.
There were still three more beings he needed to devour before Lyriana came here.
That was the priority.
As for whether his strength increased or not, Nux would figure that out when he trained with Aeliana later.
"This one's quite interesting as well."
Felberta commented, her eyes glimmering as she waited for Amaya to reveal the ninth
one.
Amaya nodded back, and with a wave of her hand, the devouring mist disappeared, revealing another being with a semi-transparent body with swirling texts or symbols constantly shifting within him.
Nux raised his eyebrow when he saw how the being looked, and Felberta continued,
"Aetherialis.
By touching an object, person, or book, they can absorb its knowledge and temporarily gain skills or abilities tied to it.
The amount of knowledge they absorb depends on how strong their minds are."
Nux stared at the Aetherialis, surprised.
"It is almost as if these beings are created to be devoured by me."
He couldn't help but comment.
"Indeed."
Felberta chuckled.
"They are much more intelligent than people around them since their strength depends on their intelligence, but despite that, they are severely limited.
After all, there is only so much knowledge one can absorb at one point.
If they try to
go beyond that, their minds are overloaded.
It often leads to some part of their memories being washed away, or sometimes, depending on the severity of the
situation, a complete mental wipeout.
This is also the reason why, despite sounding quite useful, not many higher-level worlds were attracted to this race."
Felberta then sighed dramatically and eyed Nux.
"If only there was a being who could absorb as much knowledge as he wanted without
any issues, how amazing would it be if such a being had their power, no?"
Nux chuckled when he heard her words.
Without waiting, he devoured the Aetherialis
as well.
This one came from a low-level world, so again, his bloodline was pure.
Yes, with this, Nux got another strong bloodline that now belonged to a high-level
"Now this is the tenth one."
Amaya continued, revealing a crystalline being with sharp edges.
"This one's a Shardkin.
When critically damaged, he shatters into smaller shards, which can combine
together, and when they do, his physical strength rises by a factor of two.
If you get this ability..."
Nux didn't need to think anymore and devoured the Shardkin.
"So, one more left, right?"
He questioned, and the women nodded.
"This is the one I caught at the end.
A Harmonic.
He can release spores that influence plant growth.
These 'plants' create hallucinogenic
clouds that confuse the enemies.
These plants can also bind and even 'eat' the weaker enemies, and again, the more energy used, the stronger these plants.
Nux nodded in understanding as he devoured the last 'victim.' And now, it was time to rebuild the Elven Queen's foundation from scratch.

chapters.title: Chapter 1799 I am older than you.
paragraphs: "I still do not understand why mother needs to take the Trial."
Ariana commented as she stood in front of a Trial Tower, waiting for her mother to come out.
"They didn't say anything."
Elijah, who stood next to her like a good husband, shook his head.
"Before this, she also went to the Succubus Progenitor to put her in an illusion, reliving her entire life.
She is preparing for something, and she is not willing to tell us what it is."

Ariana muttered as she lowered her head. Elijah then gently held her hand and said, "Even if she is hiding something, it must be because she is trying to protect you. Due to recent changes in Yrniel, the Ancestral Order has become much more active than it used to be a few centuries ago. Because of that, they have opened up with Father, who is acting as a moderator that relays the Ancestral Order's instructions to the normal people of Yrniel.
This has also given Father a chance to converse with high-level members of the Orders who know more about the world outside Yrniel. From everything Father has heard,
That place is nothing but dangerous.
Let alone Incomplete Divines, even Complete Divines are pretty much cannon fodder there. Even the cultivators a stage above Divine are not safe there.
The last thing we want is to attract the attention of such a fearsome world, and I am sure your mother wants the same. This is why she is keeping you in the dark; the less you know, the better."
Elijah then placed his hands on Ariana's shoulders, and with a serious look on his face, he spoke,
"So don't waste Mother-in-law's efforts, okay? She won't like it."
"My mother is going to this dangerous place you are talking about. Do you think I can stay silent and not do anything about it?"
"You are worried, I know that, bu-"
"There is no need to be worried; everything will be fine."
Elijah's words were interrupted by another voice.
The new Queen of the Elven Kingdom and her husband turned around, and their eyes fell on the previous Queen.
"Mother."
"Mother-in-law."
The two greeted.
Lyriana nodded. She then glanced at Ariana and said,
"It was my decision to leave and explore the Outer Space, and I do not want any of you to get involved."
"I understand."
Ariana nodded. Against her mother, she couldn't say what she wanted to.
Lyriana nodded back and walked ahead. In front of her was Riona, who seemed to be waiting for her in silence.
The previous Queen nodded at Riona. Riona nodded back, and just as she summoned the Cosmocraft, Lyriana walked in.
Ariana tried to say something, but in the end, she couldn't. Riona, who saw that, smiled a little. She glanced at Ariana and said,
"She will be safe. I assure you, I will bring her back to you in one piece. And when I do,
I hope to see a strong queen instead of a nervous little child, okay?"
"I am older than you."
Ariana retorted.
Hearing those words, Riona just chuckled.
"Indeed you are. I am still in my sweet sixteen, after all-"
With a chuckle, she walked into the Cosmocraft, and a few seconds later, the
Cosmocraft flew away.
Aisha, who was looking at the Cosmocraft from a distance, turned towards her mother and said.
"I still do not understand why you would give away such a chance to her."
She complained.
Before Lyriana, Nux had come to Eisheth, wanting to sever her connection first. After all, Eisheth was his wife; Lyriana, currently, was not.
It was a choice that Nux could make easily, at least for now.
Eisheth, however, denied and told him to sever Lyriana's connection first-a decision that shocked all the women, including Lyriana.
"Heh."
Eisheth, however, just laughed out loud when she heard that question. Her eyes stared
at the obu where the Chemooraft dieanneared
"This is the reason you are only a child and I am the mother."
The Succubus Queen's smile widened, her purple eyes glimmering brightly.
"I do not understand."
Aisha frowned.
"Even if you want to use this in the future, being connected to Nux means being able to feel his emotions all the time, no matter how far the two of you are.

It doesn't matter how many 'turns' you exchange that for; it is a losing trade." It wasn't just Aisha who thought that way; every wife was the same. These women desperately desired to be connected with Nux, and the worst part was that they knew that, according to their plan, it might take decades before one of them got their turns.
In such a situation, Eisheth giving up that opportunity was quite surprising.
"That woman needs it more than me"
Suddenly, Eisheth muttered with a serious look on her face.
"Huh?"
Aisha frowned.
Eisheth turned towards her and said,
"I do not need to know what Nux feels; she does."
Aisha narrowed her eyes, and her mother continued,
"That woman may look strong from the outside, but she is quite weak. Her heart is full of uncertainty. After all, unlike us, she doesn't have Nux constantly showering her with
love.

I have spent quite a lot of time with that woman, and I have come to like her, even if her personality is somewhat boring. I do not want her to lose her mind, because if that happened, not only would I lose a close friend...
Nux will blame himself as well,"
Hearing those words, Aisha turned silent.
"Of course, don't you worry, I'll make sure that elf pays for it in the future, and I'll make her return the favor with interest."
Eisheth replied with a grin. Her eyes glimmered as if she already had a plan ready.
Aisha, however, was now big enough to see through her mother. She could tell that her
mother had no plan whatsoever.
She was just... doing it out of goodwill.
Aisha chuckled inwardly, not saying anything anymore.
"Are you ready?"
On the other side, Lyriana, who stood in front of Nux, nodded with a solemn look on
her face.
"Don't be nervous."
Nux chuckled.
Then, he walked towards Lyriana and pulled her close to him. Her breasts touched his
chest, and her face instantly turned red.
"W-What are you doi-"
She tried to question as her body froze, unable to react.
"Shh."
Nux, however, interrupted her, bringing his face close to hers such that their
foreheads touched. Then, he whispered,
"Don't say anything. I need to be as close to you as physically possible for it to work."
"O-Okay."
The previous Elven Queen nodded as she closed her eyes, unable to look at Nux, who was so close to her. She had no clue why her heart was beating so quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 1800 I still don’t see the problem here.
paragraphs: "Look at the difference in treatment."
Felberta chuckled as she watched the scene in front of her.
"He barely touched those men when he devoured them, and when it's her... he needs to be 'as close to her as physically possible."
"He doesn't change, does he?"
Riona laughed out loud.
"Do you want him to change?"
Felberta questioned.
"I do not-"
Riona smiled.
The two women chuckled.
"Tsk."
The third one, however, wasn't as amused.
"There are too many of them around him."
She commented.
Hearing her words, Felberta and Riona glanced at each other and shook their heads. Their eyes conversed with each other.
'That's your daughter.'
'I apologize!
Of course, Amaya had no clue that this exchange was happening. Even if she did, she probably wouldn't care; her mind was thinking of ways.
"I wonder if that Prismorn's power to control emotions can be used to erase one's feeling of love."
The devourer muttered, and the two women standing beside her were horrified.
Once again, they glanced at each other, and once again, their eyes conversed. 'Your daughter!"
'I apologize! I apologize!"
"Alright, let me remind you of the entire process, okay?"

On the other side, Nux, who was clearly taking advantage of the Elven Queen, spoke with a serious look on his face. Of course, even now, he hadn't released the woman. After all, this was 'important' for this to work.
"Y-Yes, that w-would be good in c-case I missed s-something.."
Lyriana stuttered as she nodded, her eyes still closed.
Nux smiled and then continued.
"I will first sever your connection with the Universe. With that, no 'rules' of the Universe would apply to you anymore.
I will then devour your cultivation, turning you into a mortal.
Then, using my Blood, we will rebuild your entire foundation, turning you from a mortal Cultivator to a Complete Saint.
You have already lived a life where you went to the Ancestral Order and lived as a Complete Cultivator, correct?"
"Y-Yes. Lady Lilith helped me with that."
Lyriana nodded.
At her words, Nux frowned. Then, as if he realized something, he chuckled.
"She told you to say that, didn't she?"
"W-Well, she did help me, so it is true..."
"That sounds like something she would do."
Nux nodded with a smile.
Lyriana, on the other hand, continued,
"But I couldn't break through the Divine Stage inside the Illusion."
"That's because you weren't satisfied with the Law you were about to form. The illusion reads your heart, your deepest consciousness.
I am sure you have solved that problem already, correct?"
"Yes, I know what Law I wish to form now."
Lyriana nodded with a determined look on her face. "Good."
Nux praised.

He then pressed the woman's back, pushing her even closer to him. He could even feel her beating heart." Because of Lilith's Illusion, your foundation as a Complete Saint will be stable. So the moment you become a Saint, you will form your Law and become a Divine Stage Cultivator. Is that clear?"
"Yes."
Lyriana nodded.
"Let's continue."
Nux spoke, and suddenly, Lyriana moved even closer to him, wanting everything to work perfectly.
This sight made Nux chuckle. He, of course, readily accepted her advance, and suddenly, Black Mist was released from his body, surrounding both of them.
In an instant, Lyriana's connection with the Universe was severed, and once again, the Universe couldn't react since it couldn't sense anything inside the Reaper's Veil.

Without wasting any time, Nux moved to the second step and devoured Lyriana's Cultivation. Then, a drop of his blood entered Lyriana's system, instantly boosting her cultivation, turning her into a peak Saint-level being.
"Now form your Law."
Nux moved away and spoke with a solemn look on his face.
Lyriana closed her eyes, ready to form her Law.
As a previous Divine Stage Cultivator, she already knew what a Law was. She was confident that all she needed to do was focus, and she would be able to form her Law.
However...
A minute later, a frown appeared on her face.
"Don't try to rush it. Be calm and break through your restrictions."
Nux's voice echoed in her head, and her frown disappeared.
Another minute passed,
Five minutes...
Ten minutes...
An hour...
'Something's wrong...
Nux realized it.
This shouldn't be happening.
Lyriana already knew what Law she was going to form. All of this should be fairly easy.
It shouldn't take so long.
And as if affirming those thoughts, Lyriana opened her eyes and frowned.
"I cannot form my Law"
"Why?"
Nux frowned.
"It feels like something is stopping me. No, it is as if something is missing."
"Missing?"
Nux frowned.
"Yes, and I do not understand what it is."
Nux's frown deepened, and suddenly, a voice was heard.
"A Universe."
Nux's Shadow then moved, materializing herself to her rightful place (Nux's arms).
"A Universe?"
Lyriana frowned.
"Mhm, what's missing is a Universe that can acknowledge your Law."
"But Nux..."
Lyriana turned towards Nux.
"The one I acknowledged or accepted as a Universe was you, not your Law."
Nux realized.
"Then why don't you..."
"I cannot just will it."
Nux replied.
Lyriana frowned, unable to understand what he meant.
"How is he supposed to acknowledge something he doesn't even understand?"
Shadow became the translator.
"So what you are saying is..."
"He needs to understand your Law before he can acknowledge it."
"But that isn't possible...
One cannot comprehend someone else's Law..."
"Well, normal people cannot."
Shadow shrugged as she turned towards Nux.
This was the same monster who comprehended Absolute Death through the Umbrasol Progenitors' memories. Heck, let alone comprehend, he even combined their
understanding and formed something much more complete, much stronger.
"So how are we supposed to continue?"
Lyriana continued.
"Nux needs to comprehend your Law.
The most efficient way to do that would be... to see your memories."
the solution to Lyriana's problem would be to read her mind...
Reading all her memories, something no one with a sane mind would allow him to do.
After all, if he does that, all her secre-"
"I still don't see the problem here.
If we already know the solution, why aren't we proceeding?
You should have a way to see my memories, don't you?" Lyriana questioned with a confused frown.
